tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag mchan can gyi/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba brtag pa gcig pa le'u bco lnga po sh+lau ka stong dang nyi shu lnga pa'o// rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ḍā ki ni badz+ra pa n+dza ra ma hā tan tra ra dza kalpa nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa/ kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' chos 'byung bem sa bcas dwangs pa chu dang / /go skabs med me dang 'byed pa rlung dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang gzhi gnas khang / /sems can mngon byang lnga/ khams dang yid 'ong dang / /sbyang gzhi bcud sems can snod dang phyi 'jig rten dang / /snod bshad pa sa dang sa 'og bar snang dang / /bcud yid dang lus dang ngag dang ni/ /gnyis med ye shes gcig la gzung 'dzin gnyis dang dngos po dang dngos med kyi mkha' bde dang / /phung po lnga de'i chos nyid dang drug dang 'byung ba lnga dang skye mched drug gnyis dang / /khams gsum 'dus ma byas bzhi dang khams gsum zag med kyi ye shes dang skye 'gro rnams dang ni/ /khams bco brgyad zag med stong pa dang gcig gis nyi shur ma tshang dang / /'dod khams la sogs pa khams gsum ma lus pa dang ni/ /'dod pa la spyod pa rtag par zhen pa pha dang bu dang ma mo dang / /phyi rol gyi 'dod pa'ang chags pa dang bral ba dang ni nang dang yid kyi ye shes la gnas pa gzugs med ngam/ /btsun mo lhan cig spyod ma kun rjes su 'brang ma dang chos dang ni/ /thams cad khams gsum gyi las so so'i las dang gang zag la bdag med dang / /'bras bu rgyun du zhugs pa lags kyi de'i lam rgyu dang bya ba byed pa'i gang zag zhes/ /rang rgyal gyi 'bras bu bsgrub bya lam rten 'brel sgrub thabs lta ba rdo rje dang /

/sems tsam la mos pa de bzhin chos thams cad kyi kun gzhi rnam par shes/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / /nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi yid chos kyi dbyings mnyam nyid dang ma byung dang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes bya ba nan tan/ /yid kyi rnam shes so sor rtogs pa nam mkha' ye shes lnga'i mkha' dang spros pa dang bral ba rang dbyings dang / /dbu ma ba bdag med pa dang bdag ces dang / kun brtag gzhan dbang yang dag kun rdzob sems dang sems byung / /kun btags pa med pa la sgro btags pa dngos po med dang yang dag 'dra med kyi snang tshod du/ dngos med min/ /bde ba can dang gzhi'i yan lag chos 'byung du gru gsum dang / /a li las zla ba a skyes dang ni skyon bral ka li las nyi ma dang / /de gnyis kyi bar gyi sa bon rdul bral dang ni sdig bcom de la spro bsdu dang / /sku yongs su rdzogs pa rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin kun tu bzang po rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin dang / /mthar ni gtso 'od du zhu ba zhi ba'i bde rig glus bskul nas 'bras bur bzhengs pa dang / /bsam gtan mthar phyin chos dbyings gsang ba mchog dang dgyes pa shes rab so sor rtogs pa/ sbyin pa mnyam pa nyid/ brtson 'grus bya ba grub pa/ tshul khrims dang bzod pa me long la/ /sangs rgyas kun khyab sems dpa' ni/ /chos sku stong pa'i mkha' las gzugs sku sems can gyi don du 'gro ma yi stong pa'am yum/ thabs sam yab/ rdo rje gur/ /chos sku spros pa dang thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' ltar ci yang mi dmigs pa rgyu rkyen gyis ma bcos pa/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /de nyid sku thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pas lha yi bdag po gcig pu nyid/ /sprul pa'i sku yis rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang ma bsdus pa'i thams cad bdag nyid chos sku rang bzhin gyis rtag pa la sogs rtag tu bzhugs/

/sho lo ka 'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje/ /sprul pa'i las ni dkyil 'khor lnga rigs kyi bdag po gsungs pa/ /thugs kyi rigs rdo rje can dang sku'i rigs phan pa'i dang / /de bzhin yon tan gyi rigs rdo rje gzi brjid nyid/ /gsung gi rigs/ pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /'phrin las kyi rigs/ rta bdun rgyal po lnga pa 'o/ /gtso bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shar du dkar mo dkar/ lhor chom rkun ma ser/ nub tu ro langs ma dmar/ /byang ghasma ri ljang dang dbang ldan/ puk+ka si sngo/ /mer ri khrod ma dkar/ srin por gdol pa dud kha/ rlung du g.yung mo sna tshogs mdog 'o/ /gtso bo rdo rje phan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shar du/ skam pa dkar sogs/ lhor zhags pa ma nyid dang / /nub dol ma zlum/ dang ni byang du lcags kyu 'dzin/ /dbang ldan sogs su me tog ma dkar/ sogs bdug pa dud kha mar me dmar/ dri chab ser/ mtshams kyi char/ /gtso bo rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shar du dkar ba la sogs/ nyi lag ma dang mar me ma/ /rin chen sgron ma glog lag ma/ /dbang ldan sogs su dkar lā s+yā+e la sogs ma le ser/ nir ti ljang / gir ti dmar/ mtshams char ro/ /shar du dkar po pad ma chos 'byung lcag sgrog dang / /'khyud ma gar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang ldan du gling bu ma ser sogs pi wang ma dkar/ rdza rnga ma dmar/ mu kun ta ljang / mtshams kyi char/1 3/bdag nyid phyag mtshan g.yas pas bsnams/ skam pa lags cha byad sbyor bas so/ /gtso bo rta yi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shar du rdo rje dkar/ sgo lcags lde kyog ma/

/sgo ma dang ni gos 'dzin ma/ /de bzhin mtshams su spyan dbang ldan du ser/ la sogs ma ma ki mthing / gos dkar dmar/ sgrol ma ljang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de rnams kun/ /rkang pa g.yon pa pad ma dang zla ba dang ro'i snying khar brkyangs pas gnas/ /snying khar g.yon rnam/ g.yon bcangs sdigs mdzub ste/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'od zer cher 'bar ba'o/ /'khor gyi 'phrin las shin tu tha mal pa'i zhe sdang zhe sdang che/ /gsal la mi rtog pa/ gau rī la sogs rab tu grags/ /shin tu tha mal pa'i gti mug rmongs chen las/ /rnam par mi rtog pa skam pa ma sogs ches bzung ngo / /shin tu tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gzi brjid cher gsal ba/ /rang rigs pa'i ye shes nyi ma la sogs rab tu grags/ /shin tu tha mal pa'i 'dod chags bde ba chen po chags chen las/ /pad sogs chos kyi dkyil 'khor du'o/ /tha mal pa'i phrag dog chen po'i sgrib chen las/ /theg pa dman pa la 'jug tu mi ster sgo lcags ma sogs myur 'gro bdag /shin tu zhe sdang chags chen las/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ /gtso bo'i gsung gi 'phrin las rgyal ba mgon po phan pa ni/ /las dang rgyu 'bras bu'i chos bstan nas gti mug thams cad zad par byed/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /gdul bya'i nga rgyal gyis rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'phrog /rta mgrin 'dod pa chen po ni/ /'dod chags can gyi bde ba chen po'i byang chub ster/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro phrag dog che ji ltar che na/ /theg pa gzhan la smad pa'i sgo nas ni rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang 'joms pa'i rgyal po che/ /mi bskyod chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'byung pa'i gnas/ /gdul bya'i skye med mi bzad mgron gnyer phyir/ /gti mug la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lnga ni 'joms pa po/

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par dag par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhe sdang sku yis don mdzad pa'i 'phrin las gti mug nga rgyal dang / /'dod chags ser sna'i can gyi skye bo rnams/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba la bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gzugs ni de de la dga' ba'i du ma 'dzin/ /ci ltar zhe na shin tu gdug pa drag po la/ zhe sdang dang ldan pa/ /'dul thabs zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /drag po 'dul ba 'di mkhyen rdo rje can chen ni/ /rang gis kyai rdo rjer mi spyod par gyur/ /skur 'debs shin tu stong par zhen rnams kyi/ /las 'bras yod min brtul zhugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnam snang / las 'bras la rmongs pa gti mug spyod don du/ /rdo rje 'dzin nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyur/ /shin tu nga rgyal rnam pa bdun/ gdug rnams kyi/ /skye 'gro'i nga rgyal zad par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje nyi ma shin tu gzi brjid che ba bdag nyid rgyal/ /nga rgyal chen po'i tha mal pa'i mun pa 'joms/ /byang chub sems can la chags bral las skyes spangs/ /rang gcig pu sems can gang zhig bde byed pa/ /sems can la chags pas byang chub rab grub yang na 'dod chags lam du byed pa/ phyir/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug gyur/ /thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gnas shing / /gang zhig nyan rang gi lam gzhan nas 'gro ba/ /de rnams la bla na med pa'i byang chub rab sbyin phyir/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro rang gtso bo/ /skus don mdzad pa bsdu ba dbang po gang dang gang dang bsam pa dang mos pa lam nyid/ /de dang de yi gang la gang 'dul du ngo bor 'gro/ /mchog tu phan pa lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/

/sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin nyid kun gyi rnam snang la sogs pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /'dul byed gang dang gang gi dngos po yis/ /gdul bya skyes pa rnams kyi yid sbyor ba/ /des na de yi rang bzhin ji ltar mos pa 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs nor chos can gyis bsgyur ba ji bzhin no/ /gsung gi mdzad pa bsdus pa gang dang gang gis theg pa'i bye brag 'dul ba yis/ /sems can rigs tha dad pa 'dul bar 'gyur ba ste/ /rang gi mos pa dang mthun par de dang de yi rnam pa yis/ /chos kyi bshad pa bya ba 'o/ /des don byed pa'i tshul ni sems kyi rdo rje las sems skye med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du byung ba'i/ /de nyid ma rtogs pas sems can sna tshogs las dang lus rang bzhin can/ /sems ni ye shes yin yang glo bur gyi dri mas bdag gi rnam rtog gis/ /skye bo dri mas des bsgribs pas nag por byas/ /de bas kun tu thos pa la sogs pa rab 'bad pas/ /sems kyi rdo rje glo bur gyi dri ma rnam par sbyang / /sems glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa ni bde ba sangs rgyas yin/ /nyon mongs dug ni thams cad 'phrog ye shes su 'char/ /'o na sems gang gis sbyong na gal te stong pa nyid kho na sems sbyong ba'i thabs yin na/ /de tshe yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid mi 'gyur/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na 'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min rgyu 'bras mthun dgos pa'i phyir/ /de bas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs ni stong pa nyid gcig pu bsgoms pa ma yin/ /'o na stong pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa ci zhe na/ spyir yang dag pa'i lta ba rnams las log rnams dang / /khyad par du dngos por 'dzin pa bdag tu lta ba 'tshol rnams kyis/

/gang zag dang chos su bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /shes rab gcig pus mi grol bas de phyir dkyil 'khor bskyed pa 'khor lo sngon du song ba'i zhes/ /thabs rdzogs pa ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /de bas na sangs rgyas bskyed pa nga rgyal sngon du song ba rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas nyid du myur bar 'gyur/ /bskyed pa bsgom pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnam pa ci 'dra na ston pa phyag zhabs 'khor lo sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo sen mo zangs kyi mdog la sogs dpe byad brgyad bcur ldan/ /de phyir yon tan gyi rnam pa kun thabs kyi bsgrub bya bskyed pas dang / /de ni 'bras bu yon tan gyi rnam pa rnams rgyu thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /gzugs sku thams cad kyi rnam pa chos sku mchog tu zhi ba'i sems can lam zung du 'jug gi sgo nas 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o sho lo ka so bdun dang rkang pa gnyis so/ /des mchod pa'i yul yang bstan to// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'chang khams gsum las rnam par rgyal bas thob/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa rdo rje gur/ /'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig mchod pa lam gyi yan lag yid 'ong ba/ /'khor la mchod pa'i dbye ba rab tu bka' stsal pa/ /glu ni sgra'i rang bzhin la sgra mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo yin pas rdo rje can la 'bul/ /gar ni lus kyi bya ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /hi ra rin 'byung / mchog la de bzhin dag pa yin pas dri/ /ro dag pa yin pas 'jig rten rje la bza' dang btung / /reg bya yin pas gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la/

/'di rnams 'da' bar mi bya bas dam tshig dam pa ste/ /rdo rje mchod pa 'khor gsum dag pas byas pa yis/ /rdo rje can kun rigs lnga mnyes par byed/ /mdog mthun pas a ka ru nag kyai rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan dan dkar/ /tsan dan dmar po 'jig rten rje la 'bul/ /kha che gur gum rdo rje snang ba la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i las thams cad pa yin pas thams cad de/ /hūm̐ tha mal pa'i dri ma dmigs pa las/ rdo rje las byung pa'i dri/ /'di dkyil 'khor la sogs la thogs pa med pa rnams dri yi rab sbyor ba tha dad lha dad la dbul bas/ /'bras bu dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'thob bo/ /ro kha ba tsha ba dri chu rdo rjer dbul/ /mngar ba dri chen rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rak+ta rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tsha g.yas su 'jig rten rjer/ /ro'i bye brag rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam/ /yang na a ru ra la sogs ska ba rab tu brtag par bya/ /kyai rdo rje rdor can gyi/ /me tog shing gi rtsa ba las byung la mdog gnag rkang thung 'byung / /me tog dkar po ma lī ka dang ma la ti/ /kun da rtag tu sangs rgyas dbul/ /shing gi ut+pal/ dbang mchog dri med mdog ser po/ /snang byed la ni sbyar bar bya/ /ut+pal dbang mchog dmar po chu skyes dang / /ban dha dmar po bha ṭa laṃ/ /pad ma gar gyi dbang la dbul/ /rta mchog rdo rje can la kun/ /de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi tshad rdo rje can gyi khru gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor khru bzhi lus chur zhing pa/ /snang byed la ni bdud rtsi lnga khru lnga nyid/ /pad ma gar dbang drug pa de'i bde ba dang ste/ /lcags kyi rgyal po de bzhin bdun/ de'i steng du dga' bral dang lhan skyes dang / /bza' la sa 'dod non 'grub pas rdo rje nyi ma yi/

/las su bya ba yin pas lam du lcags kyi mchog gi dang / /gnyid las gti mug dag pas sangs rgyas mgon po yi/ /rjes chags yin pas shin tu bde la gar dbang gi /glu gar g.yo ba yin pas/ de bzhin rol mo'i sgra/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung bar chad bsrung ba dus su ni/ /rdo rje mi spyod pa'i/ khro bo'i gzugs su gzhag nas ni/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba rab tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje'i dbang po 'i pho brang sngon po ste/ /zla ba chu shel rnam snang gi thub chen gyi/ /rin 'byung mkhar phyin skyes pa'i me tog ser po/ dmar/ /pad ma rā ga dmar po spyan ras gzigs/ /rta yi yang mar ga ta ste/ ljang khu/ /rab rin chen lnga yi rdul tshon mchog /de nas zhar la las phran tshegs gsungs pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i gur 'byung po bgegs 'dul ba'i he ru ka phyag bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /bgegs bsrung ba la'ang mi 'da' bas dam tshig yang dag rab phye ba/ /tshogs gnyis sngon du song bas kun tu bzang po'i sa bon bdag /hūm̐ de las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las dbang po in+ḍa ni la sngon po lta bu'i 'od/ /phyag bzhi khro bo 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /sgeg pa mdzes pa'i khro bo yi ni lus/ /dbang ldan gdan pad nyi'i steng na 'byung po mnan pa ste/ /g.yas par rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /lag pa g.yon pa bsdigs par mdzad pa skyi lpags nyid/ /gnyis po dag gis yum la 'khyud pa phyag rgyar sbyor/ /zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas gdan la yang dag gnas/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs pas bgegs 'jigs par byed/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba dbu dang sku la rgyan mchog ste/ /mgo dbu skra 'dzings byed du zla ba bcing bar ni/

/gnas sam gdan/ ri yi rtse mor yan lag gsum dang ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /des gang 'grub na 'byung po 'dul ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin du ma 'byung po dang / /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang / /mi mo lha yi mdzes ma ni/ /bsgrub pa po yis nges par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'grub/ /de'i sngags ni oṃ bhu ta 'byung po/ ḍā ma rā 'dul ba/ bhu da 'byung po/ ā dhi pa ti bdag po/ a sho bh+yo ki ri ti na gtum po'am rol pa sarba thams cad/ bhu ta 'byung po/ pre ta yi dwags/ pi sā tsa na sha za/ sa dha ya sgrubs shig hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i mi phyad pa/ rdo rje gur 'tshogs pa'am bdag po stobs po che'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /'dis las ci byed na char chen rab tu dbab bya ste/ /dngos su bris pa'am yang na paṃ las/ pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ /der ni klu brgyad shar du mtha' yas nag po/ lho nor rgyas dkar po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du stobs rgyu sngo/ me dang bden bral du pad ma pad chen ser/ rlung du dung skyong ser/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan sna tshogs mdog dgod par bya/ /stobs po cher ni rab sbyar bas/ /de rnams snga snga ma zer/ ma dbus su bsdus pa bya khyung gis yang dag mnan/ /char dgos pa med pa'i dus su stobs po che las bsgrub pa ni/ /chu yi tshogs ni dbab par bya/ /de'i mtshan nyid kha dog gnag cing cher 'od gsal ba/ /klu 'jigs pa yang bya khyung ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /sbrul gyi steng na/ mkha' lding rdo rjes mnan mdzad pa/ /phyag brgyad rnams kyis ni klu bdag bsnams/ /oṃ āḥ phuḥzhes pa yi sngags zlos shing /

/hūm̐ dag nang du chud byas te/ /phaṭ swāhā/ ni mtha' ru sbyar bar bya/ /spyi bor dang po'i rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /gnyis pa g.yas zla 'od bzang po nyid/ /gsum pa g.yon ser po'i mdog lta bu/ /bzhi pa rgyab dmar po nyid du brjod/ /sbrul gyi rgyan brgyad gyis yan lag brgyad/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes gzhug dbang bskur te/ rdo rje sems dpas rnam par brgyan/ /dgos pa/ klu rnams kyis ni char dbab phyir/ /bsnyen pa'i lha stobs po che ni rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas rigs drug par rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'dzin pa rdo rje'i gur sprul byed smra ba pos sangs rgyas kyi sngar bstan pa'i las thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ de kho na sa zin par bya ba'i phyir dbye bar bya'o// ༈ // skad cig ma dang po dang gnyis pa sngon du song ba'i gsum pa la/ rdo rje pad ma 'o byas dang / /ri dwags brgyan pa skad cig bzhi pa la zos pa dang / /rdo rje chu byang sems ma nyams pa 'thungs nor ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas de nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'di rig dang / /bde ba chen po 'khor lor dag pa'i gnas ni gnas chen po/ /chos 'khor 'bras bu sogs mgrin pa la sogs sangs rgyas kun gyis rab gang pa/ /byang sems kyi sprul par rdo rje rin chen kun khyab par/ /rang byung gi ye shes su gang 'gyur nga yis bshad par bya/ /steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar ba las kyi rlung g.yos pas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas phan pa'i grong khyer yid 'ong sprul pa'i aṃ bskul te/ g.yas ro ma nas me 'bar ba'i mes snying mgrin gyi 'khor lo bsregs te/ bar/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /sna bug g.yas pa nas song ste zhen pa chen pos sangs rgyas kun/

/de sa'i 'khor lo bzhi bzhus ta/ེ lcags sgrog rdo rjes bcing par bya/ /bdag gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te dga' ldan du ni ldeg par 'gyur/ spyi bo'i byang sems dang 'dres nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'dod pa 'thob/ g.yon rkyang ma nas bab ste 'khor lo gnyis kyi yig 'bru bsregs de lte bar babs pas mi rtog pa skye/ /rgyal ba mgon po de'i phan yon phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma ring nas 'du bar bstan te byams pa ni/ /ye shes spyan gyis rnam par gzigs sgrub po la byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /yum gyi mkhar dkyil 'khor nag po bsgoms te/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcings pas/ /ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing par bya/ /gang zhig dngos grub mi ster na/ /lag pa lcag sgrog gis bcings nas dgug par bya/ /de'i lha rdo rje lcag kyo ba thogs pa dkar mo che/ dgug /rdo rje zhags pa ma zhags pa thog chom rkun ma/ gzhug /rdo rje lcags sgrog thogs pa ro langs ma/ bcing / /rdo rje dril bu thogs pa ghasma ri mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ye shes kyi lha la phur pas gdab/ dbang du byed/ /sngags bzlas dang lha bsgom la mngon dga' ba'i/ /drod chen po thob nas kyang sa dang po'i dngos grub gal te mi ster na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma gau ri la sogs pa bzhi yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni phur bus gdab drag shul bsgrub/ /de ni rdor rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma'i le'u dang por rdo rje gur gyis rgyud kyi nang du rgyud rgyas pa la 'bum phrag lnga bris pa 'di bzhugs tshul yang dag par bshad par bya'o/

/sangs rgyas rnam snang kyi ni dkyil 'khor sho lo ka 'bum/ /rdo rje can gyi rgyud la debazhin 'bum/ /'bum gyis rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /'bum gyis rdo rje chos kyi 'o/ /'bum phrag phyed kyis khri phrag lngas rdo rje rta/ /'byung po 'dul ba sho lo ka stong phrag lngas/ /stong phrag lnga yis las bsdom pas khri phrag gcig ni rab rgyas pa/ /stong phrag lnga yis sangs rgyas gar mkhan nyid/ /stong phrag sum cu dag la khri phrag gsum gis ni/ /ku ru ku la brtag pa 'o/ de ltar khri phrag bcu 'bum phrag gcig /lhag ma stong phrag lnga yis ni/ /cho ga'i des stong phrag bdun rim pa rgyud kun gyi'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro kyai rdo rje/ /'bum phrag lnga 'i gnas tshul lo ni bris pa 'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa blo dang ldan pa sems can yongs su bsdus pa'i thabs la mkhas pa mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur yul phyogs kyi bkra mi shes pa rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / bskyed pa brtan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar gyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /'di'i dgos pa ni gar dang glu la rab zhen pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni de dang mthun pa'i spyod pa bsdu ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan bsgyur zhing g.yo bas rol pa mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rdo rje lha'i nga rgyal brtan bar byed pa yis/ /'dod chags can gyis thabs kyis zin pa'i glu gar gyis byang chub bsgrub/ /de nas yol ba'i nang nas rdo rje can byung ste/ /me tog snyim par rab sbyor bas/ /ched du bya ba sems can kun la phan ldan pa'i/ /'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig der ni mig yon sogs la bshad par bya/ /ji skad zhe na sems can ji snyed pa rnams ni/ /sems can du bsdu bas rig bsdus pa/

/khrung khrung sogs sgong nga las skyes pa'am/ rta glang sogs mnga' las skyes pa'am/ 'bu dang phye ma sogs drod bsher las skyes pa'am/ bar do'i sems can sogs rdzus te skyes pa'am/ gzugs kyis phye ba gnyis gzugs can rnams sam/ gzugs med pa can rnams sam/ 'du shes can bsam pas phye ba gsum rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa can nyid rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa pa rnams sam/ sems can de dag thams cad bdag gis phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya'o zhes smra zhing dam 'cha' bar byed do/ /de las mi 'da' bas dam tshig che bshad de nas ni/ /mtha' gnyis las mi gnas pas zur mig mi g.yo mgon phyung ste/ /mi bskyod ye shes chos kyi dbyings brnyes ldan pa'i/ /ston pa la ni rnam par sems can gyi don la bskul ba smod/ /ci khyod kyi dam tshig gang zhe na hūm̐ zhes bya nga'i dam tshig yi ge/ /chang zung stod smad rgyud mde'u rnams khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug dang nor rgyas dang glog tu bsam nas hūm̐ zhes pas 'gengs pa la thub pa chen po gzhu can yin/ /nga min gzhung 'gengs pa snying rje'i stobs dpal ldan bya ba yin no/ /'o na khyed rang gi bdag stobs bcom pa min nam ci/ /yang rnam snang gi 'jo ki la ci khyod kyi dam tshig nga'i dam tshig yig ge oṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni 'o na bram ze rig byed 'don pa na oṃ zhes brjod pas khyod bram zer 'gyur ro/ tshangs pa thub pa rnams/ /bram ze nga min 'o na ci zhe na rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /khyod ni bā+ai ro tsa na'i sgra las drangs pas me bcom 'dod pa bral bya bar 'gyur ro/ /ci khyod 'od dpag med kyi dzo ki la dam tshig nga'i dam tshig a zhes bya/ /mnga' bdag a a ka sha'i sgra las drangs pas mkha' lding mkhyen nam ci/

/mkha' lding nga min 'o na ci zhe na pad ma gar dbang dpal/ /khyod ni dbang gi sgras gar mkhan nyer bzhad rgod mkhan du 'gyur ro/ /don grub kyi dzo ki la ci khyod dam tshig nga'i dam tshigs yi ge traṃ zhes bya/ /traṃ tsha tra'i sgra las khyod ni gdugs te tsha ba 'phrog /gdug sa nga min 'o na ci zhe na rdo rje nyi ma dpal/ /gdugs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam khyod ci ltar min/ /don grub kyi dzo ki la ci khyod dam tshig khaṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni kha a ka sha nam mkha' mkha' stong rang bzhin no/ /stong pa nga min rdo rje mgyogs 'gro yin/ /khyod ni rta ru 'gyur ro ste pha rol 'gro/ /mā ma ki'i 'bag la ci khyod dam tshig snying po baṃ yin snying rje chang / /e ma baṃ chang gi sa bon yin pas chang 'tshong mdzes ma 'o/ /mi g.yo zhes bos nas bdag chang 'tshong min mā ma ki /mā ma ki'i sgras zhang po'i grong khyer chang ma bya bar 'gro bas 'dzin nam ci/ /sangs rgyas brgyan la ci khyod dam tshig lam yin pas zhi ba nyid/ /zhi bar tshul 'chos pas bud med g.yo rgyu 'dzin nam ci/ /bdag ni g.yo sgyu can ma yin lha mo spyan/ /spyan yin na ni g.yo sgyu can zur mig tu lta bas g.yo dang bcas/ /gos dkar mo'i la ci khyod dam tshig paṃ zhes zlos pas 'dod chags che/ /smad 'tshong ma la ci ste 'phyar smrar yod/ /bdag smad 'tshong ma min lha mo gos dkar mo/ /thams cad dkar ba'i phyir ci ltar dri ma dkar ba yin par 'gyur ro/ /sgrol ma la ci khyod dam tshig dbang byed che/ taṃ zhes zlos pas/ /btsun mo'i 'o na khyod rgyal po'i pho nya yin nam ci/ /bdag pho nya min zur mig sgrol ma 'o/ /sgrol ma mig ni long bar 'gyur ro/

bcom pa yin/ /mig yon long ba ma yin te bdag ni gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi nor dpal ldan/ /spyir brtsad pa ni de ltar dam tshig sa bon la sgra skyon yod pas ngo tsha med pas legs/ /ngo tsha med pas spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas min/ /spyod pa dang khas blang mthong dang mi mthun nyung du smros/ /de nas rdo rje mig yon po smod pa pos skad zer ba des smras pa gsungs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang zer bas zhe sdang che/ /don gsal ba thub pa rnam par snang mdzad mi rtogs pa rmongs/ /'dod la bde ba la zhen pa 'jig rten bdag /yon tan gyi nor dang ldan pas ser sna rdo rje snang byed de/ /'phrin las sogs ldan pas skyon ni don yod thams cad byed/ /'dren pa lnga ni nyon mongs pa dang bcas pas skyon ldan no/ /gzhan yang dam bca' ba dang 'gal te sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa 'am/ /drod gsher skyes dang mtha' 'khob bzhin/ /gzugs can rnams dang gzugs med dam/ /rdzus nas skyes pa nyid dang ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bya 'o zhes/ /khyod kyis dang por dam bca'/ gsungs pa ni/ /khyod nyid sngon du sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /de rnams ji ltar nyon mongs pa'i dgra las rgyal ma mdzad/ /de nyid phyir khyed kyis na brdzun gsungs pa/ /zhes gtso bo la bos nas mnga' bdag ji ltar sngon dam bca' 'di ma gsungs/ /de ltar sems can bslus nas khyod kyis gang / /sangs rgyas nyid de ngo mtshar rmad/ /ngas brdzun smras pa ma yin te sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus/ 'chi ba'i tshe 'am mu ge 'am/ /phas kyi 'khor lo'i gnod pa 'am/ /dge ba'i phyogs rab gnas dkyil 'khor rigs lnga'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sbyin sreg dang / /char pa med dang sdig pa dang bkra mi shis pa zhi ba la/

/de dag gi ched du zlos pa sngags dang lha bsgom par ldan par ni/ /gang zhig bdag ni dran te rtag rol ba/ dad gus byed pa/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste/ /der ni sems can gyi don byed pas/ dang po'i dam bca' brdzun du mi 'gyur ro/ /yol bas bcad pa'i nang du slob dpon lnga dang yum bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /mi g.yo'i bdag nyid yol ba'i phyir smod pa po/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan steng ma'am nang mar rol par mdzad/ /'big rgyu khams 'dul khar gong rdul pa de bzhin shing gi rtsa ba 'am/ /ma dag pa las byas pa yi rgyan rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar mkhan 'gro ba 'dul ba'i 'phrin las gar/ /bde ba thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par dga' bar byed dang bcas/ /chos 'byung tshogs kyi khang pa rim pa gsum pa'i nang du grong khyer bde ba bskyed pa'i gnas yin pas/ nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje glu gar las mi 'da' bas dam tshig glu yis dang / /rdo rje rtse gcig pa la sogs pa'i rkang pa'i goms pa'i gar/ /mthar ni lha mo brgyas rdza rnga la s+yā+e sogs/ /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po rab ster ba'i/ /de nyid 'di ni snod ma yin pa la ches gsang ngo / /ma gsang na rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' rtsa ltung bdun pas 'byung bas ji bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad pas gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /glu sna tshogs dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / gar dang des sems can 'dul bar 'jug pa dang / /yul phyogs su char dbab pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma he badz+ra rdo rje gur rdo rje gur nyid gyi ting nge 'dzin la rnam par zhugs te/

'byung po chen po rnams tshim par byed pa'i gtor ma gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i sa nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po rgya che ba gdengs kha gyen la phyogs pa/ /paṃ gsum las pad ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs dkar dang nag dmar ba bsgom par bya/ /dbang po shar gyi 'dab mar bsam/ /mthar byed lhor ni dgod par bya/ /chu bdag nub kyi pad ma la/ /byang du gnod sbyin dgod par bya/ /mer ni byin za chen po nyid/ /bden bral mtshams skyong de bzhin no/ /rlung du gnas med bsam par bya/ /dbang ldan du ni 'byung po gtso/ /nyi zla tshangs pa la sogs dang / /tshangs pa'i rigs ni dam pa dang / /tshangs pa 'dun na 'don nyid dang / /dga' ldan 'thab bral gnas pa dang / /rgyal po chen por gyur pa dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang bsgyur nyid dang ni/ /gang zhig 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang / /gtsang ma'i gnas su ris kyi lha lnga gang gnas dang / /nub phyogs/ bde ba can na 'dug pa dang / /lha gnas/ 'og min du ni gnas pa dang / /'di'i nub na'am ri rab kyi byang na/ 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa dang / /de kun steng du gnas par bya/ /chos 'byung nang du son pa ni/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan nyid/ /pad chen pad ma bzang po can/ /lha min sems can dmyal ba rnams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'og tu 'o/ /oṃ dgu las dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ las tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /hūm̐ dgu las dbus su mi bskyod pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ las ma chags pa la sogs/ /a dgu las dbus su 'od dpag med/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ las stobs kyi rgyu la sogs/ /thams cad kyang lag gnyis gdong gcig ldan rnams te/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po che/

/bar gyi dbang po la sogs nag po mtshungs/ /rang mtshungs rig mas lus spras nas/ /rdo rje dril bus lag pa brel/ /g.yas brkyangs pas ni stan la gnas/ /de nas dbang bskur te rigs bdag tshangs sogs rtag pas phyag rgyas gdab/ /mchod sbyin brgya sogs rdo rje yis/ /stobs kyi rgyu sogs gar dbang gis/ /de ltar lha thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum las skyes pa'o/ /ye shes kyi mgron dkar mos lcags kyu thogs pas dgug par byas nas ni/ /chom rkun mas zhags pa thogs pas ni zhags 'ching bas/ /ro langs mas ni lcags sgrog bcing bas/ /ghasma ri ni dril bus dbang / du bya'o/ /de nas mchod yon zhabs bsil dbul/ /sngags 'di yis ni bsang gtor bya/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyis ni zhal bsil 'thor 'thung dbul bar bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra rdo rje/ swa twa sems dpa' sa ma yā/ dam tshig ma nu pa la ya/ rjes su skyongs shig dri ḍhā+o me bha ba/ brtan pa'i rang bzhin du bdag su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du bdag su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ dga' ba'i rang bzhin du bdag sā swa to me bha ba/ dbugs dbyung ba'i rang bzhin du bdag a nu rak+to me bha ba/ rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin du/ hri da ya snying po/ m+me bdag a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba shin tu mnos par thams cad/ sid dhi dngos grub m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ bdag la gsol/ sarba kā r+ye ṣu tsa m+me thams cad bya ba stsol cig tsi ta pre ya ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ snying la gnas par mdzod cig ha ha ha ha ho/ ye shes lnga/ bha ga wan bcom ldan 'das/ sarba thams cad/ ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa/ ma mā+e muñca bdag ma gtong zhig badz+ri bha ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ sa ma ya swa twa dam tshig sems dpa'/

āḥ/ muḥ/ /muḥ/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur rdo rje ming gi dbang gi dus su me tog gang la phog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ skyes pa dang / bud med kyi rdo rje'i ming phye ba'o/ /rigs pa'i dbang lnga las rnam par snang mdzad/ ming gi dbang gi dus su ni/ /me tog la phog pa'i slob ma bdag nyid dbang bskur bya/ /de'i dgos pa da ltar rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur ba/ /dbang po rab skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ la sogs par ming de nyid du/ /bā+ai ro tsa na'i bzhad pa'i/ rdo rje zhe sdang dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhe sdang dang / mdzes pa'i rdo rje ra ga dang / /rol pa'i rdo rje zhe sdang dang / rin 'byung gi sogs shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje rat+na dang / shin tu dga' ba myu gu'i rdo rje zhe sdang dang / pad ma 'dod chags rdo rje dang / pad ma myu gu rdo rje 'dod chags dang / 'od dpag med kyi sogs/ a la la rdo rje zhe sdang dang / pad ma lcags kyu rdo rje rā ga dang / ye shes rdo rje mo ha dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rdo rje rat+na dang / don grub kyi sogs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje rat+na dang / shes rab las kyi/ myu gu'i rdo rje dang / snying rje'i myu gu'i las rdo rje dang / dam par rat+na dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / mi bskyod pa'i drug shin tu bde bar rat+na dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs 'dod chags kyi rdo rje dang / 'jug pa'i rdo rje las dang / nam mkha' rdo rje las dang / shes rab las rdo rje dang / pha rol mo ha/ phyin pa'i rdo rje dang / 'dod chags rā ga rdo rje ni 'og min du dag pa'i gnas su rat+na/

phyag rgya chen po grub pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas tsam na rdo rje'i ming ni 'di rnams so/ /bud med rnams kyi 'byung ste/ mi bskyod pa'i/ rdo rje snyems ma dho sha dang / rdo rje mtshon cha ma gzhong dang / rdo rje e ma'o bde ma gzhong dang / rdo rje bdag med ma gzhong dang / rdo rje spyan ma mo ha dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mo ha dang / rnam snang gi rdo rje dkar mo mo ha dang / rdo rje sgyu ma mo ha dang / rdo rje 'bar ma rat+na dang / rdo rje 'khri shing ma rat+na dang / rdo rje mgyogs ma rat+na dang / rdo rje ro langs ma rat+na dang / rin 'byung gi rdo rje lcags kyu ma rat+na dang / rdo rje a ba li rat+na dang / rdo rje 'phreng ma rā ga dang / rdo rje la s+yā+e ma rā ga dang / rdo rje bzhad ma rā ga dang / rdo rje 'khyud ma rā ga dang / 'od dpag med kyi rdo rje phye ma rā ga dang / rdo rje pad ma rā ga dang / rdo rje 'byung ma las dang / rdo rje chen mo las dang / rdo rje 'dod chags ma rā ga dang / rdo rje sgrol ma las dang / rta rgyal gyi rdo rje do shal ma las dang / rdo rje sgeg mo dho sha dang / rdo rje blo gros ma las dang / rdo rje kong ka na las dang / rdo rje lā lā ma rdo rje nor yang zer las dang / rdo rje dbugs dbyung ma las dang / rdo rje rnam pa ma ni las mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po/ rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ du gyur pa/ kyai mi bskyod pa rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rnam snang chen po dang ni rang 'byung dang / /rdo rje ra li skem pa'i khro bo dang / /de bzhin du yang rdo rje khro bo nyid/

/rdo rje bdud rtsi bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang / /he ru ka dang snying rje'i stobs nyid do/ /rnam snang gi rtag pa dang ni gti mug rdo rje dang / /rnam par snang mdzad dang ni thams cad skyob/ /sgyu 'phrul dang ni de nas oṃ mdzad dang / /sku yi rdo rje rab tu grags pa dang / /sa snying dang ni gti mug chen po dang / /gshin rje gshed dang tho ba'i dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gshegs dang shākya thub pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhes byar bcu bzhir rab tu grags pa 'o/ /rin 'byung gi rdo rje nyi ma de nas rin chen bdag /de bzhin du yang rin chen rgyal po nyid/ /rdo rje gzi brjid dang ni rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bdud zil non dang ni snang byed do/ bdun/ /pad ma gar dbang gi rta mgrin dang ni 'jig rten bdag po dang / /rdo rje chos dang spyan ras gzigs dang ni/ /pad ma gar dbang dang ni 'dod chags dang / /'jig rten mgon por rab tu grags pa 'o bdun/ /rta mchog nas dam pa'i rta dang rta yi rgyal po dang / /bdun gyi rgyal po de nas lcags rgyal dang / /dam tshig rdo rje dang ni rta mchog dang / /de bzhin du yang las kyi rdo rje nyid/ /don yod dang ni don yod grub pa dang / /rdo rje mgyogs 'gror rab tu grags pa'o/ bcu /rdo rje 'chang gi rdo rje sems dpa' de nas rdo rje can/ /rnam par rgyal ba phyag na rdo rje dang / /dpe med ro mnyam shin tu dga' ba dang / /dam pa dang po bde ba chen po 'o/ /de dag bsdu na/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /don grub dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa' rin 'byung nor bu ni/ /'di rnams rigs ni drug tu brjod/ 'phrin las/ /thun mong gi 'dod pa'i thar pa mchog bsgrub pa 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgya nyi shu'i/ thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o sho lo ka so dgu dang rkang pa dag go/

༈ //rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ a khro'i/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni gsum pa 'o/ pad ma/ /bzhi pa las sna tshogs brtag pa zhes/ /rdo rje'i a kro'i brtag pa lnga pa 'o/ /brtag pa drug pa khro bo stobs po che/ /brtag pa bdun pa mi g.yo mgon/ /brgyad pa lha mo rnams kyi gzungs kyi brtag pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro sgrol ma ku ru kul+le dgu/ /bcu pa 'byung po 'dul ba'i brtag pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcu gcig pa/ /'jig rten dang 'das pa'i dngos grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ /sgrol ma'i brtag pa bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje phag mo bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa ni gzi brjid che 'od zer can/ /bdag med ma'i brtag pa bcu drug pa/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi bcu bdun pa/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la ni bco brgyad pa/ /dbyangs can gyi ni bcu dgu pa so sor 'brang ma/ /sngags kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa'i sbyin sreg brtag pa nyi shu pa/ /sku gzugs la/ rab gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /rigs bsdus pa'i rdul tshon gyi/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i brtag pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis su ni brjod/ /lha mnyes par byed pa/ gtor ma'i brtag pa nyi shu gsum/ /nyi shu bzhi pa sta gon gnas/ bum pa sta gon sogs/ /rigs thams cad kyi/ mngon par rtogs pa nyi shu lnga/ /de bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya nyi shu drug /las phran tshegs byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /glu yi bye brag ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /gar gyi bye brag dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cur gcig med sum cu pa nyi shu dgu/ /brtag pa sum cu par ba ri yan gyis gsung ni bshad/ /brtag pa re re la le'u/ stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyis ni/

/mkha' 'gro 'i brtag pa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ brtag pa/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /kyai rdo rje 'i rgyud du ston pa rdor 'chang gi /rgyud ni rdzogs ldan gyi dus sam 'og min du/ e ma rgyas bstan pa/ /'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje'i/ /gces pa bsdus pa/ dag pa'i snying pos yongs bzung pa brtag pa gnyis su/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros rtsod dus su'ang mi yul du gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'i nges pa 'o/ /kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /brtag pa/ dang por rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ rang byin brlab gtso bor ston pa'i/ /brtag pa phyi ma/ phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ston pa bud med gzung phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na spros pa rgyas pa brtag pa sum cu pa/ las brtag pa gnyis su bsdus pa lags/ bskal pa bzang po la 'di la skyes pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang slob dpon dang slob ma so so'i skye bo rnams tshe thung zhing dbang po rtul bar 'gyur na/ ji ltar na rgyud rgyas pa de rnams blo la 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na rgyas pa de rnams yongs su rdzogs pa thos par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams sems nus par 'gyur/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa ji ltar na tshe thung bar 'gyur ba lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig gang dag slob dpon so so'i skye bo rnams su 'gyur ba de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / gang dag slob ma gsang sngags/ spyod pa po de rnams ni spyir mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur ba dang / slob ma/ gang dag so so'i skye bo de dag

khyad par du srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag ma mo'i 'jig rten mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dod pa la 'dod chags/ zhen par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir na rgyud thams cad kyi bstan pa brtag pa sum cu pa/ rgyas pa 'dzin par nus pa ma yin no/ /de nas rigs lnga'i bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtog par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyud rgyas bsdus kyi gnas lugs thos nas/ mnyes par gyur cing rgyud bsdus pa zab pa la dgyes pa rnyed nas tshig rigs dang mthun pa'i byas la bsngags pa 'di gsungs pa/ sku khro bor bzhugs pa snying rje chen po kyai rdo rje che/ /a khro nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /bsnyen bskur phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa can la dngos grub ster/ /mtsho skyes pad ma rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong / /sha ri ram bzhugs pa'i sku gdung zab mo'i mchod rten dang / /rkang 'thung shing rtsa ba gcig pa/ rlon pa'i 'og tu ni bsgrubs na/ /nga ni bā+ai ro'i sangs rgyas dngos grub ster/ /tshong dus dang grong brdal nyid dang ni/ /yang thog rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes mi g.yo ba brtan pa dang / /rin 'byung gang bsnyen bskur can la dngos grub ster/ /glu gar nyams dga' ba'i gnas rab tu 'ching ba dang / /chang 'tshong ma yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad ma gar mkhan nga / /bsnyen bskur can la dngos grub ster/ /yul gyi bye brag rtag tu mgyogs 'gro zhon 'gyur dang / /res 'ga' rkang pas lam du 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod brtan pa nga / /dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya rnam par tha mal pa'i rtog pa las rgyal ba'i de mngon du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/

sku dang gsung gi phyag rgya dang thugs kyi phyag mtshan yang dag par bshad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi brtag pa las/ /rtogs pa phyag rgya rnam gsum shes par bya/ /sku la hūm̐ gis sbyangs pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa la rdo rje 'dzin sogs lag pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lces sngags bzlas pa las ngag phyag rgya/ /sems gnyis med mtshon pas phyag rgya 'dzin pa la mtshan ma'i phyag rgya yin/ /sems kyi phyag rgya gzhal yas de nyid bsam gtan dkyil 'khor lo/ /rnam snang gi shar gyi lha mo lag pa g.yas pa skam pa ste/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /ming mkha' 'gro skam pa ma 'jigs gti mug 'joms ma/ /'phrin las/ gdug pa rmongs pa rnams kyi 'khur ba nas bzung nas 'don/ /lho'i lha mo'i g.yas pa'i lag na zhags pa ste/ /'phrin las gdug pa rnams bcings rnam par dgug /de ming 'di zhags pa ma zhes bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /nub kyi lha mo'i/ g.yas na nya rgya zlum po ste/ /'phrin las/ gdug pa rnams ni bkri bar 'dod/ /'di ming ni rtag tu dol zlum bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /byang gi lha mo'i lag pa g.yas par lcags kyu ste/ /'phrin las gdug pa rnams ni dgug par 'dod/ /'di de ming rdo rje kyo mar bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug la mtshams kyi lha mo'i ming gis sdigs mdzub ma/ /rin 'byung gi shar gyi lag pa g.yas par nyi ma ste/ /'phrin las/ gti mug mun pa rnam par 'dral/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mar ni bshad/ /'di ni ming rdo rje nyi mar 'dod/ /lho'i lha mo'i lag g.yas mar me'i sdong snod de/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs mdzub bo/ /'di de ming rdo rje mar mer bshad/ /'phrin las rnam par rtog pa'i ser sna'i rab rib brjod/

/nub kyi lha mo'i lag pa g.yas na rin po che/ /'phrin las sems can rnams la 'dod don sbyin pa ster/ /g.yon par sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /ming rin chen sgron mar 'di rab brjod/ /glog ni byang gi lha mo'i lag pa g.yas par te/ /'phrin las rnam par rtog pa'i chu sbyin sprin 'joms/ /de 'di ming glog lag mar shes bya/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs mdzub ma la s+yā la sogs ming gis shes/ /snang mtha'i shar gyi lag pa g.yas par pad ma ste/ /pad ma'i 'phrin las 'dod chags kyi nyes pas ma gos pa brjod par bya/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub ma nyid de/ /'di ni ming mkha' 'gro pad mar bshad/ /lho'i lha mo'i g.yas par ba ga'i pad ma ste/ /'phrin las bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni ming chos 'byung mar ni brjod/ /nub kyi g.yas pa'i lag na lcags sgrog ste/ /'phrin las byang chub zhen pas kun 'ching ba/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni ming rdo rje sgrog mar brjod/ /byang gi sangs rgyas 'phrin las rjes chags 'ching ba yis/ /bdag nyid snying rjes 'khyud mar 'dod pa ste/ /byang chub chags pas rab bsgrub ma/ /'di ni ming rdo rje 'khyud par bshad/ gling bu la sogs ming gis go /don grub kyi shar gyi g.yas pa'i lag na sgo lcags te/ /'phrin las ye shes kun gyi rtog pa las bsrung ba mo/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de ming rdo rje sgo lcags brjod/ /lho'i g.yas pa'i lag tu lde kyog ste/ /'phrin las/ ye shes blangs nas rtog pa gcod pa mo/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de ming rdo rje lde kyog brjod/ /nub kyi g.yas pa'i lag pas sgo ma ni/

/'phrin las gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes pa ma spangs pa bsrung ba'o/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di ni ming rdo rje sgo mar brjod/ /byang gi lag pa g.yas par yol ba ni/ /'phrin las rang mtshungs stong pa nyid kyi btsun mo bsrung ba nyid/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /ming rdo rje yol ba mor ni brjod sangs rgyas spyan sogs 'khor lo sogs/ /de 'di gong du bstan pa'i lha mo sangs rgyas rigs lnga thams cad kyi/ /mtshon par byed pa'i phyag rgya/ mkha' 'gro ma yi dam pa'i tshogs ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pa/ /dgos pa mkha' 'gro lnga yi dngos grub ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud lha mo gtso bor gyur pas gsungs so/ /de nas sngar bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro ma'i don byed par dka' ba rdo rje'i gsung thob nas sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ngo mtshar skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'phrog pa ḍa ki'i sgra 'di ni saṃ skri ta'i skad mi 'da' ba'i ci nyi tshe ba'i dam tshig phyag rgya 'phrog pa lags sam yon tan 'di dag tu zad dam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'og min gyi bye brag 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na rgyud kyi mtshan rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i lung bstan pa yod de ḍa ki'i sgra 'di ni 'od zer can de'i yin te/ ḍai bā+ai hā ya sa ga ma ne dbyings las nam mkha' la 'gro ba'iskad kyi dbyings 'dis rnam par brtags pa ste/ ḍā+e/ sangs rgyas thams cad bā+ai kun tu gnas nam mkhar hā spyod par gang 'dod grub pas yā/

'di ni 'di la dbyibs rtags byed pa'i tshigs nye bar gyur pa mkha' 'gro mar rab tu grags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad ḍā ki ni'i sgra 'di/ saṃ skri ta'i skad ma yin te 'od zer can gyi sgra yin pa tshig 'di thos nas dga' ba mgu ba nye bar thob par gyur nas/ tshig 'di dag gsol pa/ /e ma dkyil 'khor la gtso bor ston pa'i mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ /rgyud kun las ni bla ma las kyang bla ma dang phyi ma dang / /tshig nyung bas rtogs sla don mang bas rtogs par dka' ba dang / /tshig rig dang don mi rig pa nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can gyi don la/ sems bskul ba'i phyir 'di skad gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang nyid byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di la rdo rje'i gur rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'dir ji ltar rnal 'byor ma khyad par gyi gdul bya srog gcod pa rnams dang gnyis bud med mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi ji ltar bsdu ba yin/ de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol pa/ sgo nga las skye ba la sogs pa mtha' yas pa thams cad ngas srid pa las bsgral bar bya'o zhes smon lam sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub gong du le'u gnyis par rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs na/ ci'i phyir srog chags skye bo zhe sdang can rnams gsad pa dang / gcig tu 'dod pa'i 'dod chags can btsun mo rnams gdul bya dman pa spangs lags te spangs par mi rigs so// de bas yang dag pa'i lta ba las ni log rnams dang / /'dod chags can gyi btsun mo rnams ni phyag rgyar bsdu ba'i phyir/ /'dir gtso bor mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud bshad do/

/de ltar btsun mo la brten pa'i bde ba'i thabs ni mdor bsdus pa yi rgyud du/ /tshig gzhung tshig nyung don ni rgyas pa ste/ /tshig nyung pas blo dman ma rig pa'i gnyid rab tu sad byed pa/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud kun gyi ni snying por nges/ /gdul bya dman pa'i yid skyob par byed pas sngags rnams kyi ni khyad par du'o/ /rdo rje ḍā ki ni'i sgras nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'di ḍā ki ni'i sgra don dang ma rgyud kyi che ba ni bshad pa tsam gyis ni/ /gcig pu bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis/ /sngon du snyom 'jug gi gar gyis mchod byas te/ /sangs rgyas pa dang byang sems la rang gi 'khor la 'di rang gi sgrub thabs gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' a k+ṣo dang / /gal te rdo rje chos dang ni/ /rta mchog rdo rje nyi ma yang / /ne rad ma bdag gis spangs na thabs gcig pur mi 'grub ste/ /de ci'i phyir na nga nyid sangs rgyas rigs lnga thams cad kyi/ /yum gyi gzugs kyis dngos grub skyed par byed/ /de rnams kyi ni phyag rgya ma mdzes ma nga / /de la brten pa nga ni dngos grub ster/ /gang ster na mig sman dang ni rkang byug dang / /ral gri sa 'og sgrub pa dang / /ri 1 lu mkha' la spyod 'jig rten pa'i sid+dhi rab pa dang / /mi 2snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur ba nyid/ 3/bu mo gnod sbyin mo dam pa 'gugs pa ni/ /bdag shes rab mnyes pas ni sgrub pa pos/ /mi phyed pa'i dngos grub rdo rje rnam3sa zhe sdang rdo rje sogs 'thob4 bo/ /spros pa ne rad ma bsgom pa'i phan yon rnam pa mang por ni/ /smras pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya/

/bdag ne rad ma spangs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub nges par mi 'grub cing / /'bras bu byang chub med cing lam bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa med/ /gang zhig sgrub pa pos rtag tu bdag ne rad ma dran zhing / /rtag tu rgyud sngags klog cing sems dpa' dang / /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang / /nga yi rtags bskyed pa sku ni bsgom byed pa/ /gal te don gyi ne rad ma/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te gsal la ngos bzung med par rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /thun bzhir shin tu bsgom pa'i bskyed rdzogs rim pa las/ /mngon sum du ni rtags dang don gyi ne rad ma mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i sngon du yang gzugs brnyan rab tu sbyor ba las/ /de yi dang por thun mong gi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ /de nas rdzogs pa 'du shes gsum ldan gyis rdo rje pad ma rab sbyor bas/ /mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir shin tu bde chen sbyor ba las/ /gang zhig bdag la lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyi/ 'dod ster ba/ /lus can dkyil 'khor bsgom pa de lta dngos grub 'grub pa/ smos ci dgos/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig nyi ma gcig 'du shes gsum ldan bsgom pa/ /snyoms 'jug gi rdo rje mchod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa lhan skyes dngos grub/ /ster te 'di la the tshom med/ bstan/ /bshad/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid he ru kar byas shing / /rang gi btsun mo ne rad ma ngar bsgoms nas/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor ches phyag rgya chen po 'dod pa/ /snyoms par 'jug pa de rnams la ni nga mnyes 'gyur lhan skyes rtogs/ /grogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan zhing /

/spro ba bde bas byang chub bsgrub pa dga' bar ldan pa dang / /glu dang rol sgra'i rnam pa dang / /'dod yon kun gyi bde ba spro ba dang / /sna tshogs sgeg par ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs ro yi btung ba dang / /sna tshogs gos kyi ri mo reg bya can/ /sna tshogs dri yi byug pa yis/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig bdag ne rad ma dang rtag tu snyoms 'jug gis nyal ba/ /de yi dngos grub lhan skyes ster ba nga / /phyag rgya chen po'i mngon du byed pa gnas 'dug pa/ /de yi 'dod pa ma btsun mor 'gyur ro/ /gong gi sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang zhes pa'i don oṃ a ā i ī u ū ri rī li lī e ai o au aṃ a swāhā/ sgrub pa po gang zhig sngags 'dis nga ne rad ma skul bar byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de rnams kyi yan lag tu bud med kyi sgyu ma'i bde ba yang dag pa'i gnas kyis 'dug go 'di'i sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis dang srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang dang / mngon byang lnga 'og nas ston to/ /a las rdo rje ma ni shar du sbyin par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni i las dkar mo'i gzugs can ma'o/ /nub phyogs su ni ī chu'i mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /byang du ni u rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /aṃ las nga dbus su gzhag ste/ snying po dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du lha mo bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gang zhig bsam par byed pa de'i bdag mdzes ma ste/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis zhal gcig ma'o/ /g.yas gri gug dang g.yon skyes pa'i thod pas brel ba/ stag gi pags pa bgos pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ 2shar gyi sgor ni lī dkar mo chen mo'o/ /lhor ni ai chom rkun ma'o/ /nub kyi sgor ni ai chu ma'o/

/de bzhin du byang du ni o ghasma ri'o/ /dbang ldan du ni u pu k+ka si'o/ /'tshed pa'i mtshams su ri ri khrod ma'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su ri gdol pa mo'o/ /rtag tu 'gro bar ni li g.yung mo'o/ /pu ka si 'di sogs rnams ni mtshams dang dkar mo sogs mtshams bral du sbyin no/ 5/gang zhig bdag lha mo bcu gsum rab tu sgom par byed pa yan lag rdzogs par de'i yan lag mthil du phyin pa'i dpal dngos grub sus kyang dbrog par mi nus so/ 4/lha mo thams cad kyang kha dog nag por mtshungs pa/ srog rab tu son pa'i ro steng du/ zhabs gar dang bcas pa/ bdud skrag pas khro mo chen mo/ dpa' mo/ phyag g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa mo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur dbang gis bde ba'i ngo bor byed pa mchog tu dga' ba'i he ru ka ting nge 'dzin rtsa ba'i/ gang zhig dbang ni rab phye ba/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin/ /la bzhugs te/ rig gyi gsal byed ma'i dbang ma rig pa las bzlog pa yang dag par bshad pa/ he ru ka rang gi rig ma ne rad ma skyes bu'i chus yab yum 'od du zhu ba/ /lha mo brgyad zhu ba'i bum pa brgyad po thams cad kyis/ chu gtso bo'i bum par blug ste/ /rdo rje slob dpon thugs ni rab bsgoms pas/ /slob ma yang rdo rje can rnams dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur bya/ /slob dpon dang dbang rdzas rdo rje nyi ma rab bsgoms la/ /der ni rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan sbyin par bya/ /dbang rdzas dang rdo rje 'od dpag med du bskyed thams cad sngon bzhin nges bsams nas/ 3/rdo rje tshigs bcad sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje chen po ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/

/snying kar rang gi lag pa bya/ 2/slob ma 'od dpag med du 'jig rten dbang phyug byas/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid thams cad sems dpas dbang bskur byas/ /rdo rje'i tshigs bcad gang zhe na sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang 'dis ni/ /de ring slob ma khyod ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /slob dpon 'di de sangs rgyas slob ma thams cad nyid/ /'od dpag tu bzang grub phyir ni rdo rje zungs/ /slob ma lcags mchog slob ma dang dbang rdzas don grub lha mo ni/ /yum sgrol mas 'khyud pa bsam par bya/ /slob dpon lag pas rdo rje dril 'khrol zhing / /rdo rje slob ma bdag pos dril bus dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ā dhī pa ti twaṃ abhī ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rnam snang byas nas ni/ /me tog gang la phog pa'i lha las drangs pa'i ming gis kyang ni dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhī ṣiñca mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye che ge mo rdo rje/ gang rig pa'i dbang gi dus kyi lha gang kun gyi rang gtsor 'gyur/ /de dang de bdag nyid he ru ka lnga/ /stong pa lnga sogs dag nas sangs rgyas ye shes lnga 'byung ba'i phyir/ /spang bya chos kyi rang bzhin ye shes su dag pa 'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ /rigs drug rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rdo rje snying po'i gnyis su med pa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /oṃ sarba thams cad/ ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa/ sid+dhi badz+ra grub pa'i rdo rje/ sa ma ya satwaṃ dam tshig gnas/ dha ra ya mi hīḥ ye shes kun tu 'gro ba 'thob/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kun kyang cho ga gcig pa yis/

/rtag tu tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum btul nas lha'i nga rgyal du zhugs pa bla med chos nas ni/ /slob ma rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang du bskyed la/ slob dpon la sogs rab dbye bas/ /dbang ni ci skad gsungs pa nyid kyi rgyas bshad phyis ni rdo rje lag nas lag /sems dpa' rdo rje'i de kho na nyid thog ma mtha' ma med pa 'i byang chub sems/ /rdo rje a k+ṣo bhe dag pas sems dpa' dga' rat+na chen po/ /kun tu a mo bzang po kun gyi rta mchog bdag /rdo rje snyems ma'i bā+ai ro tsa na/ bdag po'i rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang bdag rdo rje snying kar 'dzin du gzhug /yang ni der ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu sbyin/ /a las shes rab pha rol phyin skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i dril bu zhes bya ba/ /dgos pa sems can kun gyi chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong sgrogs shig pa'i don gyi phyir/ /dril bu 'di de sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ma kun gyi thams cad kyi/ /gsung de dang der ston pa'i shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /rgyal bas 'bras bu byang chub mchog brjod pa lag pa g.yon par dril bu sbyin/ /dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /'og gi dbugs 'byin de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bskyed pa ni sku'i dam tshig go/ thams cad byin nas ni/ /lung bstan pa'i phyir mi de dang der sangs rgyas par shākya thub par rang gyur nas/ /de'i rnam par slob ma chen po lung bstan te/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the rtsom med/1 3/khyod kyi 'chi bas 'jigs pa'i mya ngan med/ ces dbugs dbyung ngo / /de bzhin nad dang tsha ba med/

2/bde chen 'dod yon lnga lam du byed pas theg pa chen po ni/ /'di las nga yis lung bstan bu/ /oṃ e zhes bos nas/ ngas 'di khyod la lung bstan pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sho haṃ bh+ya ka ro mi twāṃ badz+ra sa twa ta thā ga ta/ khyod srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bsgral te/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa srid pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /kye me tog phog pa'i ming der grub 'gyur de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /ming ni sems dpa' sogs rdo rje zhes byar 'gyur/ /de ltar mchog tu dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhes sogs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis rig ma chen mo'i bum pa'i dbang bskur nas lus lhar byin gyis brlab pa las mi 'da' bas dbang gi dam tshig bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po ting nge 'dzin dbang dang 'brel pa'i lam lha'i rdo rje ston pa pos lha bsgoms pa las mi 'da' bas dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ mngon rtogs las kyi mdor bstan pa'i tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ snying kha'i 'od kyis bla ma rdo rje rnams spyan drangs la mchod cing / /sdig pa bshag sogs/ bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang don dam byang chub sems ni bskyed stong pa bsgoms nas su/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgom/ /de la 'byung ba rim brtsegs 'khor lo dang bcas pa las sangs rgyas gnas gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsams nas/ /mngon par thub pa rnam pa lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /dang po'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pas yab yum skyes bu bsams de nas/1 3/mkha' 'gro ma go ri la sogs pa yi 'khor lo rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa spro/ /dri za rang gi shes pa mnyam par zhugs nas ho oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ni/

/khu bar yab yum dbyings ye shes dbyer med du rjes su dran par bya/ /mtshams stong pas sems can gyi don mi 'dor bas pu ka sī sogs kyi lha mos bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa 'bras bu'i he ru ka 'dren pa bskul nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa'i skye mched drug pa gti mug rdo rje sogs/ /sku rdo rje sogs rdo rje gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum dgod/ 2/phyi nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab ste snyom par zhugs pa las rjes chags rdo rje ste/ 4/ye shes spyan drangs la rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhugs pa yang / 6/rigs lnga'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ dbang ni rig ma brgyad rnams kyi dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ /yang ni bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la myang ba dang / /lha mo brgyad gau rī sogs dang las kyi sogs kyis mchod pa nyid/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pas bstod pa 'o/ /rang byin brlab pas byin brlabs de nas lha ye shes su rtogs pa'i phyir/ rags las pa'am phra ba'am zab pa'i te/ /de la yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang yum gyi bye brag gi yan lag drug bsgom bya/ /phyi nas rjes la yang ni 'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig rtsa ba bcu bzhi yan lag brgyad go /cho ga'i mnyam rjes kyi go rim bsgom pa'i rim pa yis/ /mtshan ma drod kyi rtags yang dag mtshon par bya/ /dang po dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mi gsal ba sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ drod/ /gnyis pa cung zad gsal ba du ba 'dra ba nyid rtse mo/ /gsum pa gsal ba me khyer rnam pa ste bzod pa/ /bzhi pa rab tu gsal ba mar me nyer 'bar ba/ chos mchog /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste mngon sum dang 'dra ba/

/yang na rnam pa'ang mi rtog pa sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ mthong lam/ /rtags dang po byung nas spyod pa byas na de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku nye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rjes la rjes nas med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma'i rnam pa bltar/ /rmi lam rnam pa gsal la mi rtog pa skad cig 'gyur/ /rtags dang 'brel ba'i 'bras bu/ khams gsum rgyu bcud dang mi rgyu ba'i snod/ /ma lus rten lus pa med pa brten pa/ lha'i 'khor lo 'grub/ /'khor ba 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji srid rdo rje lus can sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ye shes mthar thug chos sku phung po'i blo ldan pa/ /de yi rjes su thams cad 'brang mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs sku/ /ji srid de'i rjes la skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa las byung pa 'i sems can/ /khams gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /phyag rgya chen po longs sku sprul skur rab sbyor ba/ /de rnams so so'i skye bo khyad par can 'khor du 'gyur/ thams cad bza' bar bya/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos grub kyi rgyu dang rtag dang mtshan nyid/ tshig gi rdo rje rnams thos nas/ /yid dga' zhing ngag drangs par gyur nas ni/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i tshig smra ba'i rdo rje'i mdzad par ldan/ /dngos grub 'grub pa'i rten rig ma chen mo bdag med dang / /lha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje rnam snang spyan dang bcas pa mnga' bdag dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen mā ma ki dang / /rta mchog thub pa chen po dang dam tshig sgrol ma/ /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid che rin chen sgrol ma dang /

/rta mgrin mnga' bdag chen po gos dkar mo dang bcas pa bsgoms pas ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis rlob pa nyid dang yang / /sgrub pa po'i lus kyi gong bu ril por g.yo zhing 'gul bar 'gyur/ /lan cig rgyal po drod thob nas spyod pa'i mthar/ nye rgyu spyad pas bton pa yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'phral du rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon sum byed pa po/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ gi rdo rje 'dzin pa po sku gsum dbyer med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te gong gi dang po'i skyes bu'i rgyas bshad/ mi bskyod pa'i 'khor lo'i gnas lugs tshig 'di gsungs so/ /gau rī la sogs pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ /zhal brgyad rnam thar brgyad/ pa la bdud bzhi gnon pas stobs po che/ /phyag ni bcu drug stong nyid bcu drug rnams dang ldan/ /byams pa'i thugs mi 'gyur bas dbang po'i sngon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gzi brjid chen po mtshan dang dpe byad zhabs bzhi pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ /yum dang bcas pa sgeg cing mi mgo sogs kyis brgyan pa khro bo'i gzugs can te/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /mi mgo sogs kyis brgyan pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /g.yas dkar po g.yon dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /bdud tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po bzhi mnyam par mnan pa ste/ /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog mi bskyod pa dngos su/ /der ni rdo rje spyi bor mdog nag po/ /'od zer chen po bsgom par bya/ /dbang spyi bor bskur ba yi gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas lngas ni dpral bar thod pa lngas rnam par brgyan/

/'gro ba'i nad brgyad sel ba/ glang po dkar rta sngo/ bong gwa pa/ glang dmar/ rnga mo sngo/ /mi dmar/ dang shā ra bha sngo/ byi la gwa pa/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad du ni nad brgyad gtso bo'i sku la bzlog pas kha nang du lta/ /gnyis 'thung chu dang po sna nas de nas khar/ la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa yi lha mo ser dang chu dkar dang rlung sngo dang ni/ /drod dmar dang zla ba dkar nyi ma dmar nyid/ /mthar byed sngo dang ni nor sbyin ser nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na zhal phyir lta 'o/ /skyes bu chen po bzhengs pa rdo rje 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gong gi mig la sogs la ni gti mug sogs kyi rgyas bshad/ gti mug rdo rje maṃ las mig la 'god/ /ḍaṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje rna ba la/ /sna la ser sna lce la 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /reg phrag dog rdo rje dang snying la bdag med bsgom par bya/ /de rnams thams cad phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa yin/ /sku mdog la sogs/ sna tshogs gzugs ma btsun mo nyid/ /lag pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pas brel/ /srog son ro'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /gong gi sa spyod mkha' spyod ma nyid dang rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod bshad pa/ /de bzhin rkang 'og gnas pa mo/ bdag med mo/ /sa bon tsaṃ las 'di nyid kyi ni bskyed pa cho ga yis/ /gnas gang du bsgom na dpral sogs gsum du ni gnas par bsgom/ /oṃ mdzad rgyal po chen po ni/ sa spyod/ /sku yi rdo rjes rnam par brgyan/ /hūm̐ las thugs kyi rdo rje rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas snying khar na bzhugs/ /a mkha' spyod ni mchog gi de nyid de/

/mgrin par ngag gi lam ni gsal byed brjod/ /gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /chos can la ni rigs gsum 'byung / /gong gi mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo spros pa'i rgyas bshad/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dkar mo'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /kha dog dkar mo 'od chen mo/ /dag pa'i las byed pa dkar mo rdo rje can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /lho dmar mo'i dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbus gnas par/ /chom rkun ma yi gzugs can bsgom/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /g.yas rdo rje zhags pa gzhug pa'i las byed pa mtshon chen mo/ /nub tu rdo rje dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbus gnas par/ /ro langs ma ni dmar mo khrag dang mtshungs/ /g.yas rdo rje lcags sgrog nga rgyal byed/ /byang chub bcings pa'i las byed 'ching par mdzad pa mo/ /byang du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbus gnas par/ /de nas ghas sma ri bsgom bya/ /rdo rje dril bus mtshan pa'i lag pa g.yas brel/ /gnyis par mar gad ut+pal 'dra ba 'o/ /dgug pa la sogs pa la rdo rje sgo skyong ma rdo rje brtson ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan sogs kyi mtshams su lha mo bzhi rnams ni/ /cho ga'i sbyor bas sa bon la sogs pa las bsgom par bya/ /sa ba ri byang sems kyis bkang ba'i bum pa ri rab pu ka sī dang / /tsan+ḍa li me yi thab khung rgyal mtshan g.yung mo rtse/ /gtso bo gnyis bcas gnyis med yum bdag med ma rnal 'byor las/ /mgon po de ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po yab yum rjes chags pas/

/rtog pa'i rba rlabs med pa'i bde ba 'thob/ /mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi/ sa chu me rlung dag pas 'byung pa bzhi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //shar gyi gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba thogs pa bā+ai ros mtshan pas dgug pa'i las bstan/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po theg pa nyan rang theg chen gsum gyi dam pa rdo rje'i theg pa/ ston pa po gsang sngags thams cad kyi rnam pa mngon du mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ khro bo bcu ston dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las byung pa'i khro bo ni/ /rtog pa spong bas rtag tu zhe sdang ldan pa 'o/ /nang du 'gug pa'i bsam pa ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /rab tu gnyis med kyis tha mal gyi rtog pa bkrus la 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ na maḥ phyag 'tshal/ sa man+ta bud dhe bh+yo sangs rgyas kun na moḥ phyag 'tshal/ badz+ra rdo rje/ mud ka ra hasta ya tho ba thogs pa'i lag pa/ tsaṇ+ḍa gtum po/ smod pa/ khyad par du gsod par byed pa maṇ+ḍa la a k+ṣe pa ka ra ya rtog pa ltung bar byed pa/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi che ba de nas 'dir khro bo chen po bshad pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs shing 'dar bar gyur nas/ mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa skyabs 'tshol ba dran par byed do/ /de'i sgrub pa skyes pa'i pad ma thod pa chag gas med/ /srub gcig pa dang srub gnyis pa/ /spyan ma sogs rig ma bzhi ni rab sbyor bas/ /rig ma bzhi po rang sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu dgang / /dgug par bya ba'i rkang rjes kyi rdul las gzugs brnyan byas pa thod par bzhag gyi cho ga yis/ /rkang pas mnan cing bsdig par bya/ /cho ga sku gsum bskyed pa'i yan lag bzhi rdzogs par bsgom pa yis/

/sgrub pa po'i drung du bu mo chen mo dgug par bya/ /gshin rje gshed rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //lho'i khro bo shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin po che thogs pa a khros spyi bo mtshan pas bgegs 'joms pa ni/ phyag 'tshal/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhe bh+yo mahā ḍaṇ+ḍa dha ra bi bi dha ra su rā a su rā mar+ha na bhu tā n+nīr+m+ma tha hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi che ba de nas khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa stobs po che bshad pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan rnams kyang 'dar bar gyur cing rdo rje 'dzin pa de dran nas skyabs 'tshol par byed do/ /sgrub pa po 'byung po yi dwags sha za nyid/ /mkha' 'gro grul bum zin pa la/ /lag pa gnyis hūm̐ gis las byung ba rdo rje rkang pa'ang de ltar dregs byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje btsir bas bde ba nyid/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa lag pa gnyis kyis dril zhing mnyes pa dang / hūm̐ las rdo rje 'bar bar bskyed pa'i yungs kar brdeg par bya'o/ /bgegs 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo hu lu hu lu/ mdzod cig gnyis/ mahā chen po/ pad+ma ma a mri te 'chi ba/ ku ru mahā bi ṣa na dug rnam par rtogs pa/ aḥ skye med/ snying kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgrub bya'i lus la btsan dug chen po dgug par bya/ /brgyal ba srog dang dran pa nyams pa sad par byed pa bslang pa de bzhin no/ /pad ma'i dregs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje thogs pa la a mo gha sid+dhis spyi bo brgyan pa/ nub tu pad ma mthar byed dmar po pad ma thogs pa 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo badz+ra kro dha ya mahā rdo rje khro bo chen po/

daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ro t+ka ṭa mche ba gtsigs pa/ bhā+ai ra wa ya 'jigs pa/ badz+ra rdo rje/ san+do tshogs/ ha dar+pa pā ya dregs pa/ a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po bgegs 'joms rdo rje can gyi sngags bshad pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams 'jigs nas yid mi dga' bar gyur to/ /shing shun nam shing lo rlung gis bteg pa po dang / rkang pa'i rjes kyi sa rdul blangs nas/ gzugs byas la/ shing shun la sngags dang spel la bsgrub bya de'i ming yang bzung ste/ glang sna'i gzugs tshogs kyi bdag po'i rkang pa'i 'og tu dgod cing de bgegs mthar byed kyis mnan te hūm̐ phaṭ ces bya ste/ hūm̐ gi nga rgyal byas nas rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i khro bo'i sngags kyi sbyor bas sangs rgyas rnams kyang skrod par byed na gzhan lta ci smos do/1 2/bdud rtsi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //'di'i bsgrub pa rdzogs kyi bar du shin tu legs par snod min la gsang ba ni/ /bya ba 'di ni bskrad pa rab bskul ba/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rjes bya bas te/ /bsnyen bsgrub sngon du song bas las sbyor gyi dus su nyi ma bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ bden bral du dbyug sngon can gyis gdug pa can 'ching ba ni/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo oṃ ya ma gshin rje/ daṇ+ḍā ya nī lā ya sngon po/ ṇi la daṇ+ḍā ya dbyug pa/ tu ru mdzad pa/ tu ru mu ru mu ru sarba thams cad/ duṣ+ṭan sod cig ma rā yā ma rā ya sod cig hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po skyes bu chen po 'i sngags bshad pas/

sems can thams cad dang sangs rgyas rnams srog la the tshom du gyur to/ /las sbyor gyi dus su brgya phrag brgyad bzlas pa tsam gyis dang shin tu skom bas sbyor ba'i cho gas bskul ba las/ gdug pa thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyug pas mnan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //nub byang du mahā ba la sngon po mdung rtse gsum pa thogs pas char dbab pa na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo mahā ba la ya stobs po che/ u ts+tshu ṣ+ma kro dha khro bo/ rā dzā ya rgyal po/ sarba thams cad/ nā gā nāṃ klu brgyad/ hri da yaṃ snying la gzer/ tā ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas stobs po che gtum po chen po bshad pas dug gi gdong 'jigs shing stobs dang bral ba dang / skrag cing 'dar bar gyur te/ stobs po che dran par byed do/ /rdo rje stobs kyi char dbab pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri thogs pas gnod sbyin sogs sgrag par byed pa na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo na mo a tsa la mi g.yo ba/ kā nā zur la lta ba/ tse ṭ+ṭa tse ṭ+ṭa khol bo thams cad dgug pa/ mo ṭ+ṭa mo ṭ+ṭa nyes/ tu ṭ+ṭa tu ṭ+ṭa ri bo la sogs pa chod/ gha gha gha ta ya rgyob/ gha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba skyes bu chen po bshad pas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin chen po brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /'dis ni khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ /saṃ las dgug par bya ba ste seng ge zhon par bsam pa'i cho ga yis/ /rlung gi thog tu gzhag rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor las/ /skyes pa dang ni rlung gis bteg nas 'ong bar bsgoms pas lha rnams zhugs/ /oṃ sum+bha gnod mdzes/ ni sum bha hūm̐ gh+rih+ṇa gh+rih+ṇa hūm̐ gh+rih+na pa ya gh+rih+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ a na ya ho kye/

bha ga wan bcom ldan 'das/ bid+ya rā dzā rigs kyi rgyal po/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rdo rje gnod mdzes sa 'og gnas pa yi/ /khro bo chen po bshad pa yis/ /lha min bu mo klu mor bcas/ /de dag nu ma 'dar zhing nar pa ma/ /thugs kha nas spros pa'i rdo rje zhags pas lus nges bcings te/ /lcags kyu yis ni dral nas ni/ /rang lha'i nga rgyal sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pa yis/ /bu mo thams cad dgug par bya/1 3/'jig rten gsum dgug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ 2//rang gi rnal 'byor rdo rje chos ni dbang la char sprin che/ /drag po la rdo rje sems dpa' char mchog ste/ /rgyas pa la rdo rje nyi ma yon tan 'du bas dge 'dun che/ /las thams cad la rta mchog tshogs ni chen po dang / /zhi ba la phan pa'i yang ni char sprin gyis/ /don zhags pa lcags kyu'i 'gug sogs bsgom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'gugs brjod la dor ba na/ /sa yi steng gi skye bo 'gugs pa smos ci dgos/ /rigs lnga rang gi rig ma rigs skyes bu yum lnga dang sbyar ba/ yang na gnod mdzes yab yum bsams/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa sogs rdo rjes rnam par brgyan/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ las lcags kyu la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /bu mo bkug la longs spyod bza' bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chen pos mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu thogs pas dgug pa'i dam tshig bka' bstsal to/ /na maḥs man+ta bhud dhā+e bh+yo oṃ ḍaḥk+ki hūm̐ dza/ kha ti dang ni thod lo kor btsag la yang / /rdo rje lcags kyu'i gzugs byas pa'i sbyor ba las/ /zla ba nye bar gzas zin te chags dus su/ /khar lcags kyu bcug nas ni bsgrub par bya/

/lcags kyu des gang dgug pa'i ming ni bris pa tsam gyis dang / /las sbyor dus su brgya ni gsal bar bzlas pa yis/ /skra ldan sred med/ gnas med rlung lha/ lha'i dbang po drag po dbang phyug /chung mar bcas pa dgug par bya/ /dgug pa las mi 'da' bas dam tshig lcags kyu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //spyir lha'i bsam gtan ngag sngags dang sems spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /rang kro dha yab yum/ gi rig ma skyes bu bdag /ye shes dgug pa'i gnas su gzung bar bya/ /thub pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /steng gi gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs gtso byas pas gzhan gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dhārmā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa traḥ gdugs dkar po can/ oṃ bi ma la dri ma med pa/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra bde byed 'byung gnas/ oṃ pra t+yad+gi ra tshul ma yin pa rlog par byed pa/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra bar+t+ti rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ sarba thams cad/ yan+t+ra sngags/ man+t+ra 'khrul 'khor/ mu la kar+m+ma rtsa ba'i las/ bhan+dha na tā ḍa na bcing bzlog ki la naṃ phur pa/ ma ma kri te bdag la byed pa/ ye na gal te/ kā+ai na tsi ta kri taṃ ta ta 'ga' zhig gis byas pa/ sarban+tu thams cad/ tshin+dha tshin+dha zungs gnyis/ bhin+da bhin+da/ phug gnyis/ tsi ri tsi ri phye mar gnyis/ gi ri gi ri gyis gnyis/ ma ra ma ra/ sod gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kro ta bcu bskyed/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ bdag nyid mthu dang byad la sogs pa bsrung pa'i sbyor ba las/ /gzhan gyis byas pa'i gnan pa la sogs sbyor ba rgyud sogs gzhig pa la/

/'khor lo bya ste dpung pa rig mas 'khyud byas nas/ /de'i phan yon/ 'jig rten gsum gyis 'da' mi nus/ /khro bo chen po'i gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //de dag thams cad gnas/ dben pa'am nags tshal nyid du yang / /'grub pa'am mi 'grub snyam pa'i yid gnyis thams cad rnam spangs la/ /lha'i rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pa ni las 'di bsgrubs na/ /thub pa nges par 'grub bo/ /gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /khro bo chen po'i snying po'i gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba snying po'i sngags la 'jug pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// sho lo ka brgya brgyad cu rtsa gsum mo// ༈ //kun 'gro'i dbang phyug yin pa'am/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang sems kyis kun la khyab pas de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /sems can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /kun mkhyen sku'i mdzad pa thams cad ye shes las byung pa/ /yang dag rab tu rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po nges par dbye/ /gzhal yas khang sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rnam snang gi yan lag rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje dam tshig sems dpa' sems dpa' dbus su rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gzhal yas khang rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje dam tshig sems dpa'/ rnam snang shar du dran par bya/ /sangs rgyas pho brang gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje dam tshig nyi ma lhor rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas pho brang gzugs su rab bsgoms nas/ /'dod chags dam tshig rdo rje nub tu rnam par bsgom/ /sems can rnam snang gi yan lag gzugs brnyan rnam bsgom ste/ /rta yi dam tshig don yod rab bsgom bya/ /de ltar 'byung ba bzhi 'khor lo bh+rūṃ dang bcas pa zhu ba las sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan las byung pa'i/

/mngon byang lnga las dam tshig sems dpa' dkyil 'khor rnams ni rtag bsgom bya/ /thams cad rigs lnga rnams kyi sngags bh+rūṃ la sogs pa 'di yis/ /snying kar ye shes sems dpa'i gnas su dgod/ /yi ge de dag gi spro bsdu las ye shes sems dpar rab sbyor bas/ /dgos pa sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs khar rang sngags yi ge ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdzogs pa dang / /ye shes phyag rgya dang ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' phyag mtshan brtag /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i spro dang bsdu ba byas pas ni/ /gzhan dam tshig la gzhag pa dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /sgra snyan pa dang mi snyan pa gnyis bar ma'i la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /gzhan dam tshig la gzhag pa dang ye shes kyi lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid khyad par du bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /sgra rnam par dag pa rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /gzugs sdug pa la sogs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /spyir lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal po ni/ /gzugs rnam par dag pa rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid/ /dri la zhim sogs rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /spyir lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid khyad par du bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /dri rnam par dag pa rin chen phung po rab tu grags/ /ro la mngar ba sogs rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /spyir lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid khyad par du bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid/ /rdo rje chos ro dag pa ni de bzhin gshegs/ /reg la bya 'jam po sogs rnam gsum rnam shes nas/ /spyir lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid khyad par du bcom ldan sna tshogs reg bya dag pa don grub pa/

/'dod yon 'bras bu ster ba po/ /thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung pa'i dam tshig dbus gnas pa'i/ /rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /lnga lnga'i gtso bo lnga la 'khor bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rigs lnga po re re la ye shes lnga yi rnam par bsgom/ /'dod yon gyi stegs bu la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /pan rag gam spyir 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu khyab/ /sna tshogs 'od zer gyis las ni byed par brjod/ /rigs lnga po thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /lha'am mtshan ma'am yig 'bru nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yi/ /rdul tshon lnga po thams cad gyis kyang bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rigs lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sbyang gzhi phung po lngar ni rab tu grags/1 3/sangs rgyas mgon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /shar gyi char ni rab tu grags/ /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma 'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje yi/ /byang du rta yi rgyal po yi/ 2/dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ mi spyod pa'i/ 4/shar gtso bo dang pho brang du dkar po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /dmar po nub kyi cha nyid du/ /brtsod ni byang du yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo yi logs dang ya phubs su/ /rdo rje zla phyed rdo rjes rin chen rnams kyis brgyan/ /'od zer sna tshogs snang ba rnams kyis mdzes/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor gcig la rigs lnga tshang bas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo dbus su gyur pa ni/ /de nyid rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs kyi ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi nges tshig snying po dkyil 'khor yongs bzung dkyil 'khor 'dus pa te/

rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa'am/ /yang na rigs lnga bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /'khor gyi phye ba brgyad brgyad lha mo dbus su gnas pa 'am/ /yang na bzhi bzhi'i dbu ru gnas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga ru/ /gang tshe dkyil 'khor gnyis ka'i bsdus pa yi/ /sgor ni shar du lcags kyu lhor zhags pa dang / /nub tu lcags sgrog de bzhin byang du rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i dril bu nyid/ /sgo nas 'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas kyis rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i mi 'da' bas dam tshig de skad bka' stsal to/ /dom dang bya rgod de bzhin bse/ rgyu gcig /bsnyug glang ba men dang ni stag nyid dang / /spre'u dang snas 'thung 'bo ba lang tshe/ /rdo rje chos kyi g.yas na 'o/ /khwa 'ug bya dkar seng ge dang / /mtshor gnas ngang pa de bzhin ra dang ni/ /ri dwags khri snyan phag dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yas min par ni rtag tu gnas/ /rma bya ma he chu srin dang / /nya yi rgyal po ro ho ta/ rus sbal sbrul dang / /'og gi klu dang ngang skya dang pa dang / /ri bong phan pa'i g.yas pa na/ /da sbyid sbal ba thu bo rta sbrul/ sprin shugs ha la'i sbrul kyi/ /kha chu rtsangs pa mig sman mtshungs byi ba/ /g.yag dang dri ldan gla ba de bzhin bshad/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na 'o/ /ka ran ta ka'i bya dang 'khor lo ngag ngur pa ser po/ /lug dang tsa go ra mtshan mo rgyu ba'i bye'u chung dang ni/ /bye khra hor khra 'ol ba dang / /ku rar nya khra nyi ma'i g.yas na 'o/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /rigs ldan pad ma pad bzang can/ /'jog po nor rgyas mtha' yas ni/ /rin chen rgyal po'i g.yon na 'o/
