/gza' lag phur bu mjug ring dang / /sgra gcan mig dmar pa ba sangs/ /spen pa khyab 'jug rta rgyal gyi/ /g.yas pa nyid du rab tu grags/ /dbang po tshangs pa de bzhin drag /'dod lha khyab 'jug gi bu mo gang ba bzang po/ de bzhin thong pa can/ /gcer bu mu stegs rgyal ba dam pa dang ni lha ma yin thag bzangs ris/ /gdod ma stobs ldan zhes bya g.yon na 'o/ /glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin 'bog /khong skems mdze dang rkang shu dang / /mchin pa mcher pa'i rang bzhin yang / /mi bskyod pa'i g.yas kyi glang po la sogs g.yon rnams dbang phyug brgyad sems can la rtsol ba'o/ /rab tu grags/ /lcags rtags dang ni rjed byed dran pa nyams pa/ dang / /khrag rdo gcong nad rgyal po dang / /gzhang 'brum skran dang bkres rab rlung spu gri dang / /mig ser mkhris pa gsha' ya dom la sogs pa 'o/ 'od dpag med kyi g.yas kyi/ /rdzi ma byi mig nad/ dang so nad dang / /mkhris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung / /bad kan 'dzag dang lus gas mtshan ma rdol ba dang / /rlung skya rbab 'bras ni rma bya sogs/ rnam snang gi g.yas kyi/ /rkang 'bam bol skrang ba/ tshil nad glig skrangs dang / /rgyu ma dmu chu/ 'phel dang gsud pa 'grangs nad dang / /tshad pa rims dang rab gas ni/ /ka ran sgra sogs rab tu grags/ /rlung mkhris de bzhin ma zhu ba/ /sgrib g.yogs rab rib gcing sri ba/ /gzhogs phyed na dang lkog 'bras dang / /rlung rgyas gza' lhag la sogs pa don grub kyi g.yas kyi 'o/ /mi yi 'gro ba gzhan skye gnas dang dbang po dman pa 'gro ba'ang dbang po gsal bas byang chub thob pas dam pa ni/ /rab mchog de lta bu 'gro ba/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rab mchog ni/ /mi rnams kyi ni 'gro ba ste/ /mi'i 'gro ba thams cad nad de dag gis kyis khyab mthong nas/

/sangs rgyas rigs lngar ni cher grags pa/ /bdag gi lus la sems can rnams kha gtso bo la bltas pa gzhug par bya/ /sems can rnams la nad de dag gis gdungs par ma gyur cig snyam du/ /nad rnams bzhi bcu po zhi phyir sangs rgyas rigs lnga po ni/ /glang po la sogs shas che ba'i sems can rnams nad 'dzin khyab 'jug gi bar to/ /rigs lnga phyag mtshan dang ldan pa de ltar bsgoms par gyur pa la/ /nad med ru tsa rgas pa med/ tred grum thig nag gi nad med/ /'chi med nges par khong nad med/ /nad kyi red rgyu nyon mongs pa/ nga rgyal med cing gti mug med/ /nyon mongs pa med pas 'bras bu bkres pa med cing skom pa med/ /tshe phyi ma la spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal khyad par du ngan 'gro de bzhin med/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa las gzhan pa 'dzin pa'i lha dang lha min mi rnams sam/ /bsgom pa gang gis kyang ni nad med byed zer min/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// sho lo ka so drug dang rkang pa gnyis so// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po lus de nyid rigs lnga po thams cad 'dzin pa po mkha' 'gro ma'i lus la bde ba byin pa'i sgo nas tha mal pa'i yid 'phrog pa tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ dang po dbus kyi sems kyi rjes dran mi spyod pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' dmigs nas ni/ /de nas shar gyi sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /de nas lho'i sems kyi rin chen bsams nas ni/ /de nas nub kyi chos ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /de nas byang gi las rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de nas byang gi 'khor lo chen po rab bsgom bya/ /rnal 'byor 'di bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bsgoms pa ni mchog rab ster/

/rgyud gzhan du sngar yang ma byung phyis kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dang po dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig sems dpa' rab bsgoms nas/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang ye shes gzhug pa phyag rgya bzhi yis phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje rnam snang bsams nas ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi bsgoms pas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje phyag rgya'i rnam pa bzhi'i sbyor ba yis/ /rin chen phung po rab bsgom bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya bzhi rab sbyor bas/ /las kyi rdo rjes phyag rgyas bzhis rgyas gdab/ /sbyang gzhi zhe sdang rgyal po dag pa'i rgyal po che/ /gdul bya'i zhe sdang gi skyon rnams thams cad zad par mdzad/ /mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las spro zhing sbyor bas sems can thams cad mi bskyod par bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las bsdu ba yang ni yang dag bshad/ /gti mug dag pa sangs rgyas mgon po rab bsgoms nas/ /ting 'dzin las sangs rgyas sprin gyis gzhan dam tshig la gzhag pa kun tu khyab/ /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las spro dang ye shes sems dpa' bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i byang chub rab bsgom bya/ /nga rgyal dag pa sems kyi rin chen rin po che/ /ser sna'i bdud kyi skyon rnams zad par mdzad/ /sems kyi char sprin gzhan dam tshig pa la sbyor ba yis/ /yang ni ye shes sems dpa' bsdu ba bstan par bya/ /chos 'dod chags kyi rgyal po gti mug che/ /gzhan dam tshig la dgod pa spro dang bsdu ba'i ye shes gzugs can te/1 3/de thams cad thun tshod bzhir ni byin gyis brlab/ /bsgoms na mchog gi 'bras bu myur du 'grub par 'gyur/

2/sems ni phrag dog dag pa mgyogs 'gro ltar dam tshig bsams nas/ /ting nge 'dzin las gzhal med 'bras bu gzhan dam tshig la stsol ba po/ /rta mchog char sprin chen po yis/ /ye shes bsdu ba yang ni bsgom par bya/ /rigs lnga'i ting nge 'dzin las bcom ldan 'das kyis spro ba dang bsdu ba'i ye shes mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig chen po de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gi thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūm̐ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i yid sems kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rnyog med dkyil 'khor dbus bai ro tsa na'i thugs kar gnas par/ /sku yi yi ge oṃ rnam par bsgom/ /rin 'byung gi khrag gi dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbus gnas par/ /sems kyi rin chen yi ger dgod/ /'od dpag med kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor nyi ma'i dbus gnas par/ /gsung gi yi ge hriḥrnam par bsgom/ /don yod kyi las kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /don yod yi ge'i khaṃ gzugs can te/ /sku dam tshig sku ye shes gsung / don thugs/ gsum mi phyed bsgoms pa yis/ /yig 'bru de dag las rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes rdo rjes bsgom par bya/ /ye shes kyi rdo rje sems dpa' thugs khar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mi phyed pa/ /bai ro'i bh+rūm̐ las chos kyi 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa ye shes kyi rnam snang la/ /rin chen traṃ las rin po che sems kyi rin po che/ /hriḥlas pad ma bzang po'i pad ma dmar/ /shes rab khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa don yod kyi/ /shes rab ral gri'i byed pa rnon po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam rtog phrag dog gi ri bo bcad nas ni/ /de ltar lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po ldan par 'gyur/

/de dag gis gzhal yas khang gi tshad bstan pa dpag tshad bye ba rgyas par ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin du phan pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang yang / /rin chen phung po 'od chen dang / /chos kyi phung po'i mgon chen dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje las/ tshad 'dra/ /de dag las sna tshogs 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas lha'i 'khor lo sprin gyis rnam par brgyan/ / gong gi ye shes rnam par gzhug pa'i rgyas bshad ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od kyis bsrung ba dang / chos 'byung dang / gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /ye shes spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de'i mtshan nyid 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis gang / /yid du 'dod pa thams cad du ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /mtshams kyi zer yang phyogs kyi lha mo'i ghasma ri sogs sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes dgug rgya mtsho rab bsgrub bya/ /dza hūm̐ baṃ hos dam tshig 'khor lor bcug pa yi/ /dam tshig dang ye shes rdo rje chen po dbyer med du 'bar/ /de'i dgos pa sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /dam tshig dang ye shes skad cig la ni gnyis med 'gyur/ /gong gi bzlas dang zhes pa'i rgyas bshad bzlas pa'i rten ru tra t+r+ya ra k+ṣa dung ral gri bse ru dang / /bu yi 'tsho ba po te tsa pad 'bras dang / /mu tig la sogs byi ru sogs/ /ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan par sngags bzlas bya/ /de'i dgos pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa dang / /gau rī la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo spyan ma la sogs mo/

/bdag la mngon sum du ni mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni dngos grub stsol cig par snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes chen la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros zer rgyal che la myur bas bos pa na/ /thos pa tsam gyis myur du 'ong 'gyur ba/ /de ltar skad cig sngags rig gi drung du sangs rgyas gshegs/ /tshul ji ltar byas na 'jig rten khams ni brjod kyis mi langs pa dang stong phrag dang / /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'og min mkha' grong du/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 'od zer can la sogs pa bde gnas kyi/ /rgya dang grangs mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de rnams sku dngos su sngags rig drung mi gshegs/ /'on kyang rdo rje'i ye shes spyan gyis rnam par gzigs shing byin gyis rlob/ /bzlas pa'i sngags gang gis sngags kyi rim thob pa/ /e ma sgrub pa po de yis byang chub thob/ /de nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sngags kyi spyod pa sangs rgyas pa'i dang por 'dzin/ /rdo rje lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas sngags ni rab bsgoms pas/ /sa bcu gcig pa dang mtshungs pa med pa'i bcu gsum pa'i ye shes 'thob/ /de ltar shes pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /sa bcu gsum pa'i sngags kyi spyod pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs kyi rim gnas pa/ /zhi ba myang 'das kyi 'bras bu nyid la mi gzigs te/ /de ni sangs rgyas spangs pa dang rtogs pa dang thugs rje mthar phyin pa mnyam par brjod/1 3/rim pa bshad pa ni sangs rgyas nga rgyal thabs rgyud bskyed rim dmigs nas ni/ /rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba/ /sgrub pa po gang zhig zung 'jug tu bsgom pa de bas na/ 2/sems kyi rgyud can 'bras bu'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/

/sems can bshad pa ni 'jig rten gyi sems can ji ltar rang bzhin gyis ye nas sangs rgyas de/ /ji ltar dper na chos ni rang bzhin gyi rnyog pa dang bral ba rnyog pa med/ /sems can khams ni nam mkha' de ltar bshad/ /rang bzhin gyis nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /'o na sems can du cis gyur snyam na ngan par brtags pa'i rnam rtog gis bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas/ /chags sdang gi las bsags te rin chen sems ni ci dran byas/ /sems lam gyi glo bur gyi ma dag pas ni sangs rgyas su dag par 'gyur/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar nam mkha' me chu la sogs pas mi 'jig pa/ /nam mkha' skye 'gag med pa ji bzhin de bzhin sems/ /de bas na sems kyi rin chen zab mo bskul ba las/ /sems skye ba med pa nyid bsgoms pas sangs rgyas te/ /dbang po yang rab skye bar sangs rgyas dam pa nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thob pa de bas na rin chen sems ma dag pa dang dag pa las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag sems can med/ /yul dang dbang po dang rnam par shes pa'i phyi'i gnas don dam/ /sems las phyi rol gyur pa'ang cung zad med/ /yid kyis sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa las sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /gzugs sku khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po rgyal po che/ /sems gcig gis ni skye med du rtogs pas thob par 'gyur/ /sems rtogs na phyi'i yul gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri glo bur du skyes pas/ /ro dang reg bya'i rang bzhin skyes pa yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pas/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mchog tu zhi/ /de bas na sems 'di ni 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bas rin chen mchog tu brjod/

/de bzhin du gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes nyid/ /phung po lnga po 'di dag thams cad sems la brtag pa las/ glo bur du skye/ /thub pa sa phyi'i yul 'di ni sems las gzhan mi 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /de bas na yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /lam gyis sbyangs pas 'dod don 'bras bu rab ster ba/ /sems kyi de nyid rang bzhin dag pa yin pas rkyen gyis sbyangs pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras bu ster/ /de nyid phyir na sngags rgyal gyi sangs rgyas/ /sems kyi rdo rje rang bzhin skye med bskul ba yis/ /thabs zab mo'i rnam pa rnyed ldan pa'i/ /spang byas phyed par dka' ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sems skye med snying po sna tshogs su snang ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje can chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi de mngon du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ bdag mi bskyod pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ /gong gi de la yan lag drug bsgom bya'i rgyas bshad sangs rgyas gnas ni yan lag bzhi pa rnam rdzogs dang / /bskyed chog mngon byang rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rang bzhin dang /1 3/rang gi ye shes lhag pa'i lhar sgrub dang / 2/dkyil 'khor 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi dgod pa dang / 4/mchod bstod bdud rtsi rdzogs pa'i rim pa la sogs pa/ /rim pas rjes su bsgom par bya/ mdor na/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ bstan/ ka nga /bshad pa oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dbang bskur ba/

badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje rang bzhin gyis dag pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dbang chus bskur chu rnam par dag pa mi bskyod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ ja/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mri ta bdud rtsi/ swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dbang mgrin par bskur/ gsung rnam par dag pa rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ cha/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu sti bstod pa/ badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bstod pa yon tan yin la yon tan gyi lha rin chen tog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ ca/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza mchod pa/ badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa 'phrin las yin pas de dag pa rta mchog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ ga/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na rjes su chags pa/ badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sems pas/ rjes chags bde ba yin pas de dag pa rdo rje nyi mas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ kha/'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /de'i thugs kha nas bh+rūm̐ de'i 'od spro ba dang ni bsdu ba'i lus/ /ye shes na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi yi ges bh+rūm̐ bskyed/ /des ni sangs rgyas kyi pho brang gnas dgod bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya pho brang / badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad pho brang gzugs yin pas de dag pa/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// nya//srung 'khor gyi nang du nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /'byung bzhi'i rim brtsegs bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /de yi steng du 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa sangs rgyas bsam/

/de las 'od spros nas gzhal yas gnas pho brang dgod bya/ /rdo rje lta bur rtog pas mi phyed phyir/ /des na dbus su rtog pas mi bskyod bsgom par bya/ /ma skyes yum chos kyi dbyings kyi rjes su dran pa las/ /me long ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad shar du phan pa nyid/ /rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung bas rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /'di ni lhor rin chen sems su bshad/ /nub kyi rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ gsung gi mnga' bdag /'dod chags mtshan nyid 'dzin pa las/ /rdo rje 'od dpag med sems dpa' gnas 'dug pa'i/ /sems ni 'dod chags gsung gi dkyil 'khor zhes byar bshad/ /gang phyir rgyu dang rjes su mthun par 'bras bral min sgrub ltar sems can gyi don/ /de phyir byang du don yod yum dang bcas pa rab tu grags/ /mi rig pa las bzlog pa'i rig ma mdzes pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //de ltar lam bsgom pa'i sngon du dbang 'gro bas bum pa'i dbang ni bum pa'i bya ba gtso che bas dang po ste/ /gnyis pa las ni rdzas gsang ba'am gsang gnas nas bskur bas gsang pa'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ma la brten nas ye shes skye bas te/ /ji ltar de'i nyams myong gi ngo bo lus ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bum dbang gi rten rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dam pa bris nas ni/ /snyoms par 'jug pa las mi 'da' bas dam tshig khu ba'i cho ga byang sems phyung nas zos pa las yis/ /des mtshan ma dang rnam rtog bsregs pas hom dang bde ba chen po bsam gtan rang lhar bskyed byas nas/ /de tshe tha mal pa'i las las dbugs dbyung bum pa'i dbang sbyin par bya/1 3/bum par rigs lnga bskyed pa mkha' 'gro lnga dang ldan pa dang /

2/dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga yis bkang pa dang / 4/mkha' 'gro lnga yi yum lnga tshogs ldan pas/ /slob ma rdo rje can la bskur/ /rdo rje sa bon snyoms par 'jug pa'i byang sems rab sbyor bas/ na/rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyar nas/ /slob ma rnam par snang mdzad du rtag par nges bsams te/ /byang sems lce la 'jog pa rgyun gyis rigs kyi a li gang las bab pa'i ming gis so/ /slob ma rdo rje can byang sems kyis dbang bskur/ /shes rab kyi rten spyan dang bdag ma mā ma ki sgrol ma dang / /gos dkar mo la dam tshig sgrol ma sogs bdag gzugs kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon rigs lnga/ btsun mo yum lnga/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyis rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje dbang gsum pa'i ye shes bla med bshad par bya/ /gsum pa'i nyams myong de'i mtshan nyid ye shes/ bla na med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su med cing brjod pa'i yi ge med/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba mngon du byed/ /der bde la mi rtog pa bde ba bzang po'i ro myang gis/ /dbang bzhi pa bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig ga ga bi ra na ba glang sha dang ha ha sti na glang po che'i sha zhes bya ba dang / /sha dang po'i shwa na na khyi/ mthar yang sha a shwa rta/ ldan pa'i/ /rab tu na ra na mi'i sha gsal ba dam pa nyid/ /de dag bsten pa'i dgos pa dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /cho gas rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa bdud rtsi myang / /thabs la mkhas pas 'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam sha lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin pas rnal 'byor pa/

/rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /'bras bu nad rnams thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni gzi brjid lus po che/ /'jig rten kun gyi mdog dang ldan pas yid 'phrog pa/ /blo gsal bas phas kyi rgol ba kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten kun gyi bdag pos 'khor los bsgyur ba brgyan/ /brgya byin gyis kyang mchod lha rnams kyi ni 'dren pas rjed/ /rigs la mkha' 'gro lnga'i yum gyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i chos kyi zas ni za ba po/ /dam tshig bstan pa las mi 'da' bas chen po'i bsam gtan zos pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ //mi bskyod bdud rtsi so sor bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dri chen gyis rtag pas lus mdangs dang ldan pa chu shel chen por ldan/ /rdo rje rak+ta nyi mas rgas pa med/ /don yod rgyal po sha chen po'i dwangs ma chen po ni/ /rdo rje srog gis tshe ring ba yan lag 'byung / /ga pur gyis 'dod pa'i don kun bsgrub cing dpal dang ldan/ /des na rnal 'byor pas bsten par ni brjod/ /gzhan yang mi bskyod btung pa'i sbyor ba las/ /lo stong phrag lngar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phan pa yis ni lo khri ru brjod/ /rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje'i 'bum/ /tshe dpag med kyis dpag med dang / /sha chen bdun gyis nam mkha' ji srid bshad/ /rdo rje nyi ma rak+ta dpag med si h+la dang / /tha mal pas 'khor ba'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba gnyis/ /'di dag mnyes par bsten pas rnal 'byor pas/ /kun tu bzang po 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'gyur na shes rab pha rol phyin stong pa nyid ye shes/ /'di ni rdo rje si h+la/ nyi mar brjod/

/chos rnams thams cad kyi ni bde ba chen po'i thabs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med ga pur/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' can nyid kyi/ /thabs shu kra dang shes rab rak+ta zhon pa mnyam par bsten pa dag /spyir khams gsum dag ni thams cad du/ /'dod khams rang la sa dang sa 'og bar snang la/ /khrag dang khu bas ma nyams par khyab pa'i lus/ /sid dhi thob par rigs kyi dbang phyug gis 'di gsungs/ /sen mo dang ba spu 'i dwangs ma de bzhin khams/ /khu ba la ni rnam par gzigs 'od dpag med/ /lpags dang khrag la gzi brjid che rin 'byung / /tshil dang rkang la rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad bsdus pa mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rtsa dang sha la bdun rgyal po/ /'di rnams lnga ni khams kyi dwangs ma sangs rgyas lngar/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros rnam par bshad/ /rnal 'byor pa'i sa yi khams ni rnam dag pa/ /spyan ni 'khor lo mdzes pa bā+ai ro tsa na nyid/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo mā ma ki dwangs pa ste chu/ /pad ma'i gos dkar mo bu mo tsha ba me nyid/ /sgrol ma rlung ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo bzhi rnams ni/ 'byung ba bzhi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gur gyis de rnams bka' stsal to/ /sngags bā+ai ro tsa na la sogs pa thams cad rnam par dag pa la bdud rtsi lnga mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje bdud rtsi dang rgyal ba mi phyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te le'u bdun pa'o// ༈ //gong gi lha mo bzhis bskul ba'i rgyas bshad/ bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thig ler glus bskul ba khyod ni zhe sdang rdo rjes sems can mgon med pa yongs skyong ba/ /sku gsung thugs las thugs dag ye shes lnga las chos kyi dbyings ni shin tu rnam dag pas/

/he ru ka lha yi lus ni yang dag gzugs skus rgyan mdzad pa/ /dbus kyi mi bskyod pa la dbang ldan gyi puk+ka sī ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ ji ltar zhe na/ /'khor ba dang ngan song las rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /zhal phyag gis stong pa nyid spangs skye ba gzugs skur bzhengs par mdzod/ /khyod ni gdul bya gti mug can/ gti mug rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/ /sku yi dag pa chos kyi gzugs brnyan me long ye shes gyis/ /lha yi lus ni mtshan dang dpe byad kyis yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /gti mug can rnams kyi mgon po me'i mtshams kyi ri khrod ma ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /ngan 'gro'i srid pa las rnam par 'dren pa'i 'jig rten sman slad du/ /ngan 'gro'i srid pa las stong pa nyid spangs skye ba gzugs skur bzhengs par mdzod/ /khyod ni gdul bya 'dod chags rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/ /gsung dag legs par ye shes so sor rtogs pa yis/ /lha yi yon tan gyis lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /srin po'i gtum par ldan pa bdag la myur du gzigs/ /sems can rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /thig le stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod ru pa ka ya/ /khyod rin 'byung dang don yod ni sangs rgyas thams cad ser sna dang phrag dog can yongs skyong ba/ /gzugs kun bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes dang thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes kyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /sku la 'phan ḍoṃ bhi bdag la mgon po myur du gzigs/ /ser sna can rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhengs par mdzod/ /rigs lnga thams cad 'bras bu'i he ru ka sprul skur bzhengs par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to//

༈ //gtso bo 'khor lo can rnams thams cad kyi/ /'dis glus bskul ba ni 'bras bu'i he ru kar bskyed par 'gyur bar ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis yan lag rdzogs par bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag pos rdo rje 'dzin pas de skad gsungs/ /gong gi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i chos can la ni rigs gsum 'byung gi rgyas bshad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri mkha' spyod/ badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhu tsa ri sa spyod badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā tā la wa si ni rkang 'og ni gnas pa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha gsum dgod pa sku gsung thugs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /byin brlabs gnas dpral lkog snying kha su rtag par ni/ /ye shes gsum sgrub pa po rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni byang chub 'bras bu sku rdo rje sogs rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sku rnam snang dang gsung 'od dpag med dang thugs mi bskyod pa kyi bdag pos rdo rje 'chang de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de'i dgos pa phyag rgya chen po lus mkha' spyod du/ rab sbyor bas lus lhar/ /tha mal pa'i lus sku yi rin chen sbyang par bya/ /thugs rdo rje bsam gtan rdo rje yid mi rtog pa bsams nas ni/ /tha mal pa'i sems kyi rin chen rab sgrub byed/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i gsungs pa spyod khyad par gsang sngags gyis/ /tha mal pa'i ngag gi rdo rje dri ma med/ /gti mug mig la sa'i snying po rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /tha mal pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyang / /zhe sdang rna bar phyag na rdo rje rdo rje'i bsam pa yis/ /sgra yi sgo yi bsam pas tha mal pa sbyang pa 'o/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po yis sbyang /

/ro drug la chags pa 'dod chags lce la spyan ras gzigs rdo rje yis/ /lus ni sgrib pa rnam par sel ba phrag dog rdo rje yis/ /thabs kyi rgyud la yid la kun tu bzang po yis/ /de nyid ma rgyud du mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ /lha drug po 'di rnams kyis ni nang gi skye mched drug thams cad sbyang / /gal te don par sbyang bya sbyong byed 'gal ba yod pa ma yin yang / /kun rdzob tu de tshe sbyong byed rgyal ba'i sbyang bya dngos pos sbyang pa yod/ /sbyang bya kun rdzob yod pas sbyong byed 'thad pa bden par yang dag gnas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis phung sogs lhar chos tsam rnam par bsgom/ /phung sogs chos kyi dngos po dang por rgyu las ma byung spyad pa las/ /gang zag dang chos kyi bdag thams cad rnam spangs 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'gro ba sa lha dang rigs med pa bsam par mi nus te/ /bden pa gnyis kyi chos kyi tshul gyis don dam du med kyang kun rdzob tu yod pas thams cad rnam par dag sbyong byed rang yang rtog pa yin snyam na/ /bsnan pa gnyer por che ba tshig mos pa rnams kyis slar me la gdung dang klu'i dug khyab pa'i rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba ste/ /lus kyi sman ni gzhan pa'i btsan dug nyid de/ /sbas pa gnyen por che ba ji ltar chu ni rna bar zhugs pa la/ /yang ni chu ni thabs su 'gyur ba nyid/ /ji ltar bzlog pa gnyen por che ba ste rlung gis dkrugs pa'i ste pho ba la sbos pa sems rnams kyi/ /de bzhin mkhas pas mon sran gre'u yi tshod ma sbyin/ /tha mal pa'i 'dod chags kyis kyang rmongs pa yi/ /skye bo thabs kyis zin pa'i 'dod chags me yis gdung /

/rgyu 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /tha mal pa'i sred pa dang bcas pa'i 'dod chags smad pas zad par 'gyur/ /'du shes gsum dang ldan pas 'dod chags rdo rjer skye med du yongs shes pas/ /'dod chags kyi yid ni rdo rje sems dpar bde stong du 'gyur/ /'dod chags kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs pas zhags pas 'ching pa yis/ /'jig rten pa rnams dang sred pa'i dug gi chags pas khyab par brjod/ /dpe'i ye shes kyis mtshon pa'i 'dod chags bral bas mngon byang chub/ /'dod chags don gyi ye shes skye bar mi bzhed mthar phyin rnams mi 'dod/ /de nas gtso mo rdo rje sgrol ma yi/ /bsgom bzlas sgrub thabs sbyin sreg dang 'brel pa'i las kyi ni/ /cho gas 'dod don las tshogs bcu bzhi thams cad ni/ /bsnyen pa'i sngags dang sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la 'di rnams ni bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi rkang pa rnams yin te/ oṃ na mo phyag 'tshal lo/ ar+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ bho dhi swa twā ya/ byang chub sems dpa' la/ mahā swa twā ya/ sems dpa' chen po la/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ snying rje chen po can/ tad+ya thā/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re sgrol ma myur du sgrol ma/ sarba thams cad/ duṣ+ṭan rab tu gdug pa/ ma ma kri te bdag la gdug pa/ dzaṃ bha ya/ non/ mo ha ya/ rmongs/ ban+dha ya/ chings/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ sarba thams cad/ stam+bha rengs/ ni tra ya kye sgrol ma/ swāhā/ tshogs gnyis dang bsrung ba dang rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i steng du byang chub pa lnga la sogs pa las lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya/

/phyag rgya zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis sen mo la sogs pas rnam par brgyan/ /rgyas pa la/ gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar bsgom/ /gzhon nu ma yi lang tsho dang chags pa mtshan nyid 'bar/ /rdo rje spyi bor rin 'byung nyi ma'i dbang skyes pa'i/ /phyogs bzhir rnam snang sogs sangs rgyas bzhi yi dbu rgyan can/ /lang tsho bcu drug la ni bab pa'i lus/ /rlung gis bskyod tsam na g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbang la 'od zer dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dang zhags pas dang de bzhin dung / /g.yas pas mda' ni 'gengs pa 'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyus dang ut+pal dang gzhu/1 /sdigs mdzub g.yon pas 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba yis/ /gnas sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum po ni dbang du bya ba la sogs bsgrub par bya/ /shar du me 3tog sgrol ma ste/ 2/kha dog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge oṃ las skyes pa mo/ /me tog phreng pas lag pa brgyan/ 4/phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas su ta las bdug spos sgrol ma ste/ /mdog nag mdzes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /g.yas spos dang dung gis lag pa brel/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub tu re las mar me sgrol ma ste/ /mar me sdong pos lag pa khyab/ /mdog ser rnam par rgyan chen mo/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /byang du tuta las dri yi sgrol ma ste/ /dri yi dung gis lag pa khyab/ /khrag gi mdog ltar lha mo ni/ /nang gi pad 'dab bzhi las dkyil 'khor snying por bsgom par bya/ /shar sgor lcags kyu ta las dkar/ lhor re las zhags pa ser/ nub tu tu las lcags sgrog dmar/ byang du re las 'bebs pa'i sgrol ma ljang /

la sogs rab dbye bas/ /der ni sgo yi srung ma bsam/ /steng du swa las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ser/ /'og tu hā las snod mdzes ma sngo rab bsgom/ /de gnyis g.yas na rim pa bzhin 'khor lo klu zhags yan lag bzhi rdzogs bsams nas ni/ /spro zhing sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs la sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ de ltar yi ge bcu yis lha mo bcu/ /de'i dag pa pha rol phyin bcu la gnas ma/ /'jig rten dang 'das pa'i 'bras bu thams cad rab grub phyir/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi che ba sngags 'di las rgyas pa ster bas mchog dang phul du phyin/ /sngags kyi che ba sngags de las sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /mchog yin pa ci'i phyir na bklags pa grub byed drag po ste/ /ston pa rdo rje gur gyis bshad pa 'o/ /sngags zla ba'i steng du taṃ gyi 'od kyis stag la sogs pa thams cad bkug ste thu bar btum tsam na dbugs phyir mi gtang / 'dis gos kyi thu bar lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ mdud pa bcings nas nags tshal du 'gro na yang sus kyang mi 'khyer te/ stag dang chom rkun dang / chu srin sna 'thung dang / seng ge dang / sbrul dang / mche ba can glang po che dang / ma he dang / dom dang / smyug glang ba men/ la sogs pa sgrol ma'i ming dran pa tsam gyis sems can lus nyams shing yib bo/ /sen rtsis zla gam du thab khung bri sngags 'dis ut+pa la'i sbyin sreg ji srid du lan brgya rtsa brgyad ji tsam par sngags bzlas la bskyur bar bya ste/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu ke me che ge bdag gi wa sh+mamā na ya dbang du gyur cig swāhā/ yang na yi ge bcu pa'i sngags de nyid kyis khwa'i sgro bya rog gi dang ru la lan sum cu rtsa gnyis yongs su bzlas te/

dgra'i khyim du ya them gyi steng du sbas na nyi ma bdun gyis skrod par byed do/ /de'i sngags ni oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re tsa la bskyod/ pra tsa la rab tu bskyod/ shi gh+ra ga mi nī de wa lha sbyin tat+ta u tsa ta ya skrod hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum/ de nas gzhan yang dbang du bya ba'i gzhon nu ma gye mo zhes bya ba bdag la lug bzhin du ster bar gyur gcig swāhā/ sbyor 'gyur ba/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā che ge mo/ bhi dha na rna ba phug pa/ ku ma ri ma h+ya murbā gzhon nu mas bkal ba/ he na ta ster ba/ s+ya bi tā lugs bzhin/ pra ya ts+tsha tu me gyur gcig swāhā/ spra tshil dang gtum pa skye tshe'i sa bon dang / myos byed po so cha dang / a sho ka'i lo ma dang / de'i me tog sbyin bsreg bsreg blugs bya zhing / mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bu ram du bcas pa stong phrag lnga'i sbyin bsreg ni dbang du bya ba'i bu mo'i dngos grub la rab tu bsngags te/ nyi ma bdun gyis de'i tshe rnal 'byor pas rang 'dod pa'i bu mo 'thob bo/ /de nas gzhan dgug pa'i las la yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā che ge mo/ bhi dha naṃ rna ba ma phug pa/ swa s+d+ya nā ta a kar+ṣa ya ma man+ta ke dzaḥ rang gi gnas nas bdag gi drung du khug shig sngags 'dis 'ba' dha ra'i rgya shug gi tsher ma grangs stong phrag lnga bzlas te rang 'byung gi me tog dang / bsreg blugs bya bar brjod pa 'di byas pas/ rgyal po'i skyes pa skyong pa rnams kyi bu mo yang 'gugs par byed do/7 /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma/ lag pa g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon ut+pa la dang zhags par bcas pa rnam par bris la rab gnas bya ste/

de'i mdun du mchod pa byas na/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing legs zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas/ phyi nas lha bsgom pa dang ldan par sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā che ge mo ma ma i bi taṃ sa p+naṃ kā ya bdag 'tshal bas rmi lam du gsung shig hūm̐ phaṭ/ stong phrag lngas bzlas pas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pas gang dgug par bya ba de'i mgrin par bcings te/ snying kha nas lcags kyus drangs nas bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsams te khol mo'i tshul gyis 'ong ste longs spyod bza' bar bya'o/ /de nas 'khros pa zhi ba gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i lag pa rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas mthe bong nas rim pas phyis/ srin lag gnyis la'am/ bsngags te mig la srin lag gis byug gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags par byas te/ bdag gi mig gnyis mig sman gyis bsku bar bya zhing / rgyal po 'khros pa'am dbang du bya rgyu de'i rigs kyi drung du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po slob ma dang 'dra bar gus par byed cing 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / bka' drin stsol cing snyan par brjod pa byed pa dang / bran du yang dag par 'gro zhing khros pa yang dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni mngon sum du mthong ba ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas khu ba 'dzag pa'am chags pa skye gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur sgrol ma'i gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te sbrul kha gnyis pa'i so dug khaṃ phor so btang bar bsreg cing thal bar byas nas/ ba kha dog dmar mo'i mar dang / gong gi dug de btum la a rkaka'i shing bal las sdong bu rab tu sbar la/ de'i dud pa kham phor las mig sman bsdu bar bya'o/ /mig sman de rdo rje nyi ma rang byung dang / rdo rje chos dag ga bur dang mnyes la/ rta mchog gis sha chen gyi dud pas bdug par bya'o/

/thal ba dang lhan cig mig bsku bar bya ste/ rdo rje mig gis gang bltas pa de gal te pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug mi 'bab na/ byang sems mi 'dzag cing chags pa mi skye na de'i tshe bdag sgrol ma ma lags te/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bkrongs pa lags so/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ byis pa so med pa'i lce lkog ma nas drang ste blangs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas nas/ bung ba'i rgyal po'i bh+raṃ pa ra dza ste shing mngar yin yang zer/ rtsa ba dang ba lang gi gi wang lhan cig byas pas dpral bar gang dbang du bya rgyu la thig le yongs su bzung ste/ gang bltas pa de dbang du byed do/9 /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ rang gi lto ba'i srin bu la gzungs bdun du mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ rdo rje chos byes ma dang lhan cig so rtsi ko la dang ldan pa byas la bu mo la byin te/ 'byor pa mchog so rtsi zos pa na bsgrub pa po mi spong pa dang / skyes pa gzhan du mi dga' ba dang / rang las gzhan du mi 'gro ba dang / rang gi bdag po khyo snga ma yang spong ngo /11 /de nas dbang du bya ba gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ mar khu chen po mi'i zhun/ bdag gi lus la nye bar byugs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlas la 'od dpag med du de bsgom par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar 'bras sa lu btags pas lde gu'i rang gi lus la dril ba de'i dri ma la khur ba byas te gang la byin pa de skye ba lnga por yang mi spong ngo /11 /de nas dbang du bya ba/ gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ zla ba la nye bar chags pa gzas zin pa'i tshe'i dus su sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlos shing rang gi phyag rgya brten par byas la/ de las byung pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug ga pur blangs te/

dung gi bsregs pa'i thal ba dang mnye bar bya zhing / gsang dbang du bya ba/ rab tu grags ma nyid la byin te skye ba ji srid du gnas skabs lngar yang rjes su 'brang ngo /12 /de nas gzhan dbang du bya ba yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i gzungs kyis myos byed ma da na pha la po so cha la lan da du ra'i 'bras brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te/ 'dod pa'i myos byed kyi 'bras bu des rta mgrin byams sems dang lhan cig pas bskus na dbang du 'gyur ro/13 /che ge mo bcings pa las grol bar gyur cig oṃ ta re tut+ta re tu re/ a mu ka s+ya ban+dhaṃ mu tī ku ru mu swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis shing arkaka'i lo ma la bsgrub bya'i ming phaṭ swāhā'i nang du chud par bris la/ ne'u le sre mo'i khung bur sbas na bcings pa las grol bar 'gyur ro/14 /de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'byung gnas blo rab tu 'phel ba yang dag par rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /gang gis lha mo bsgoms pa dang bzlas pa tsam gyis phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcad par 'gyur ro/ /tshogs gnyis sngon du song bas paṃ dang a las pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ dkar po las spro ba dang bsdu ba las lha mo phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma mdog dkar ba skyes pa'i yid 'phrog ma skra phyed du li ba/ gdan chu skyes shin tu dkar ba la yang dag par gnas ma/ thugs khar chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya las pad+ma'i sdong bu gnyis gyes te rna ba'i thad kar bye ba bsnams pa lag pa g.yas par pad ma mdog dkar ba yang dag par bsgoms shing / g.yon na pad ma dmar po'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa po ti yang bzhugs pa yang rna stag g.yon par bye ba rdo rje skyil krung du gnas pa 'am g.yon brkyangs ma/

rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan ma 13 de gang du bsgom na lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ las skyes ma mchog tu dga' bar byed ma/ dam tshig sems ma bskyed nas de nas ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba bsgom par bya zhing / rnal 'byor snying khar zla ba la oṃ bsam la sngags 'phreng me lce ltar 'bar ba kha nas lte bar 'jug pa 'gal me ltar bsam la bsgrub pa yis zla ba drug tu goms pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par shes rab mchog tu 'gyur ro/1 3/mtshan mo zhag bdun du sbyor bas de'i rnal 'byor pa bstan bcos thams cad shes par byed do/ /bsnyen pa/ 'bum bzlas pa'i las kyi sbyor bas nyi ma re re la tshigs bcad brgya byed par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu 'bad pa med par gzhung brgya yang blo la 'dzin par byed do/ 2/de la sngags kyi rkang par 'gyur ba/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma dang 'dra bar phra mor 'bigs pa'i shes rab bskyed pa/ 'od gsal ba 'bar bar byed pa/ dkyil 'khor nas sangs rgyas kyi skyed pa/ brtan pa dang dran pa ma nyams pa oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dz+nyā bar+dhā ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha bar+d+da ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bhu dha bar+d+da ni swāhā/ nangs par khwa mi zer ba na sngags bdun du ka dza pa mngon par bsngags pa byas te/ gang la zhe na ma bslangs pa'i shing thogs rang skyur sings po skyur po la lan bdun du sngags kyis btab par bya zhing / ji srid zla ba drug tu gang 'thung ba de shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /gong gi rig pa'i dbang lnga yang dag par bshad pa zhes pa'i don du/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid ldan pa 'gro bas de bstan pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i dngos grub thams cad blangs la brten nas 'grub pas/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /dbang rgyud man ngag 'chad pa'i mtshan nyid yang dag bshad par bya/

/de yis nye bar bstan pa'i don dam pa dang brdar btags pa'i sngags/ /nyams su blangs na sgrub pa po yis dngos grub nges par 'grub/ /spyod lam dal zhing zab mo'i de kho na rtogs pa'i chos dang ldan/ /rig pa 'i gnas lnga thams cad mkhas par bcas/ /phyi nang gi sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor bri ba dang sngags rtsa ba'i sngags sogs shes shing / /sku gzugs khyad par du byed pa'i rab gnas 'byung po mnyes pa'i gtor ma'i rdo rje slob ma la lte bar mkho ba'i pha rol son/ /cho ga'i de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /dgag dgos shes pas khyad par du mi gsod pas nyan thos spyod pa bsrung pa po/ /rgyud sde bzhi la sngags spyod rim par gus pa dang / /gzugs mdzes pa ldan skye bo thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba dang / /bsgrub pa dang / mchod pa/ bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing bzlas par ldan/ /rtsa ba'i dang yan lag gis ma gos pas ltung ba 'joms pa po/ /las la sbyor ba sogs sngags dang lus skyob bsrung ba sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten rnams ni gnas skabs kyi bde la yang sbyor bar byed/ /mtshan nyid de lta bu ldan pa la bla mar byas nas ni/ /slob ma gang zhig bla ma smod byed cing / /so so'i skye bo bla ma smod pa gang / /rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por 'tshed par 'gyur/ /mi smod pa'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kun gyis dang por mchod/ /rdo rje gur gyis sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba yis/ /de ltar bla ma'i mchod pa la nan tan bya/ /gong gi dmyal ba chen por 'tshed kyi rgyas bshad bla ma'i grib ma bud med dang /

/lham dang stan dang mal gdan khri stan rnams/ /slob ma rmongs chen gang gis 'gom byed pa/ /skyes pa de ni pu gri sa gdams pa'i lam 'dzin/ /bsnyen pa la sogs pa sngon du song bas legs par dbang bskur slob ma gang / /dbang bskur ba'i bla ma'i bka' las gsung bcag pa 'da' byed pa/ /'jig rten 'dir ni rna ba 'on par 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol rdo rje dmyal bar gnas/ /bla mas bka' bsgo ba de g.yo dang rgyu yi sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrub par nus bzhin du brdzun gyis mi nus smra ba la/ /de'i nyes pa 'jig rten 'dir khom skam mdze nad chen po can/ /dmyal ba la sogs skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar blang dor shes pa'i slob ma yis/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bskur byed pa des sangs rgyas kyi bar pha rol 'gro/ /de bas na bla ma'i bka' ni rab bsrungs na/ /'jig rten dang 'das pa'i dngos grub rgyas pa tshe 'di la sogs par 'grub par 'gyur/ /bla ma mnyes pa dang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir tshogs kyi zas ni rtag tu bya/ /zhi ba la sogs 'phrin las bzhi la rtag tu bskul/ /tshogs kyi sngon du snga bar dge 'dun chos ston bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kyang mnyes bya/ /tshogs zhu ba'i dus su bla ma la ni yon dbul zhing / /de yi rjes su 'khor du 'dus pa tshogs kun la'o/ /chos kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i sta gon bdag gi las ni brtsams nas ni/ /cho ga 'dis ni dngos grub bsgrub par bya/ /yan lag rgyan rnams stod g.yog la sogs pa kun gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan phyag rgya lnga gyis rnam par brgyan/ /slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma btang / 2/mchod pa'i bye brag me tog bdug spos mar me dang /

/de bzhin dri yi dung sogs zhal zas dang rol mo g.yas/ /g.yon du sngags kyi zhabs bsil zhal bsil mchod yon snod/ /mdun du snod ni gzhag par bya/ 4/zhabs bsil rgyud rgyas pa'i gong ma'i cho ga yis/ /me tog spos sogs rim pa bzhin/ /la s+ye la sogs mchod pa brgyad yis/ /mchod pa byas na dngos grub bzang po sbyin/ ud/ /nir me tog lag pa gnyis kyis bskyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / /dri ni mtheb srin gyis 'thor ba'i tshul gyis dang / /sdong po mar me'i mthe bong gshibs la mchod pa dang / /byug pa thal mo phyir bkyed pa'i lugs kyi rjes su dris/ /la s+ye'i lag pas la s+ye ste/ /me tog gi phreng pas phreng pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gis glu yi dam tshig glu/ /brla bskums pas ni g.yon pa'i dri'i g.yos su gzug gar ni dus mo btsug tshul nyid/ zer/ nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di bde stong gis zin pas ni bla na med/ /dgos pa sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bla na yod pa'i mchod pas mchod/ /dgos pa 'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par gyur/ 3/gsang sngags bzlas dang lha bsgom la mngon dga' zhing / /rtag tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i pha rol 'gro yang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' ji bzhin/ /'di rnams bla med mchod pa 'o/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gang zhe na me tog spos sogs mngon sum du/ /'khor gsum du dmigs pas 'jig rten spyod par gnas pa yis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa bla na med pa mchog nyid min/ /'khor gsum du rtog pa de nyid byang chub yan lag min/ /gong gi zhi ba la sogs rtag tu bskul gyi rgyas bshad/ dkar po zhi bar byed par sbyin sreg gi thab kyi mdog tsan dan dkar sogs brjod/

/ser po sdong ris sogs rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs la/ /dbang dang dgug par tsan dan dmar po la sogs dmar po che/ /tha ma'i las la dur khrod sol ba sogs nag po 'o/ /zhi ba la mchod rdzas ni me tog dkar/ /ser po rgyas pa'i rdo rje la/ /me tog nag po tha ma la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dmar po bzang / gal te pa ra'i theg pas kyang 'bras bu thob na dbang sogs dgos pa med do zhe na/ nyung ngu las/ gang zhig dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar/ /nga ni sngags pa yin zer ba/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang / /smig rgyu'i chu la 'thung dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ 3/rnal 'byor pa gang dbang bskur med/ dbang ma thob/ 2/rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / 1/gang zhig rab gnas kyi lag len ma mthong dang / /rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba gang zhig phyi nang gi sbyin sreg ma byas pa/ /skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /de yi dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /gang gis slob dpon la dbang bskur ba'i don du/ lan gsum du gsol ma btab/ /'dir ni gsang sngags spyod pa'i rigs su skye ba med/ /dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang thob nas thog mar sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bskyed rim bya/ /gang gis tshe gcig la sogs pa byang chub ma thob na/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i gnas su de'i/ /skyes nas myong 'gyur skye zhing skye bar lan grangs gzhan la skye bar 'gyur/ /khams kyi rgyal po yang na sa yi bdag po nyid/ /dag pa'i khams kyi rgyal phran gnas su mngon par 'gro/ /nub phyogs bde ba can dang 'og min mkha' grong dang / /dga' ldan du ni lha bsgo pa de blo ldan skye/ /'jig rten 'dir ni dngos grub gang 'grub pa sa rjes su dpag pas/

/sangs rgyas de ni 'grub pa smos ci dgos/1 3/chos sku'i mtshan nyid khams gsum kun 'gro'i dbang phyug yin pas bdag po chen po nyid/ /'chi ar+ya me tris/ skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /gnod med dga' ba med pa ste/ /de ni rtag dang brtan pa dang / /zhi ba'i phyir dang g.yung drung phyir/ /zhes so/ /med rgas pas khyab pa med/ /tshangs pa brgya byin de bzhin drag po dbang phyug /sgra gcan khyab 'jug me lha dang rlung lha dang ni/ /'dod pa'i lha dga' rab dbang phyug dang thong ldan lha ma yin nyid/ /'di rnams sangs rgyas de yi 'khor du 'gyur/ /gzhan yang lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha ma yin dang mi 'i rgyal po dang / /mi 'am ci dang mkha' spyod rnams/ 4/de rnams 'khor 'gyur the tsom med/ /'di ni dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa la blo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba spangs pa dang rtogs pa dang thugs rjes dbyer med pa'i ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / ga/rgyal po'i rigs dang mngon par byang chub byed pa dang / kha/de bzhin du ni lhar dga' ldan du gshegs dang / ca/khyim nas skye rgas na 'chi las skyo ba skyes nas 'byung bar byed pa dang / /mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du rab tu byung pa 'dzin pa dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang skye ba yongs su len pa dang / 2/grong rtsa mchog tu yongs su mya ngan 'das pa ston/ /zhe sdang can mi bskyod pas 'dul sogs 'dul ba'i 'jig rten mthong nas ni/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang gzugs ni rgyal rigs du ma byed/ ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs las/ /nor bu de dngos min snang ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs pas/ /khyab bdag gzugs ni du ma byed/

/ces pa ar+ya me tris gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas sems can bskyab bzhed pas/ /sangs rgyas gar ni rol pa mdzad/ /gzhan yang sems can gyi don du ri bong stag dang seng ge dang / /glang po rnams kyi rigs su yang / /rgyu snying rjes byams pa phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /smon lam gyi shugs kyis phyag rgyas grub pa skye bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bud med sgyu ma'i spros pa yis/ /'dod chags can la lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i chos gsung ngo / /bud med la brten nas sgyu ma sangs rgyas dpe'i ye shes de la don gyi ye shes des nyid/ /sgyu ma 'khor ba lugs 'byung gi rten 'brel thams cad sel bar byed/ /don gyi shes rab pha rol phyin gzugs su/ /rtags bud med kyi rnam pa rtag tu yang dag gnas/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i don gyi ye shes chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs par byed pas gnas 'dug nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu ster/ /de'i mtshan nyid bsgrub pa po'i yid 'jug pa g.yo zhing chos la dad che gsang spyod kyi dus su ngo tsha med/ /rtag tu 'dod chags de la brten nas gnyis med rtogs pas pha rol 'gro/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 'du shes gsum ldan gnas 'dug nas/ /thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub kyang ni rab tu ster/ /gzhan yang tha mal pa'i gzugs dang yon tan nor la yang / /'dod pa gang yang btsun mo zhen pa med/ /rdo rjer 'dod chags gnyis med kyi ye shes yid 'dod pas/ /rang gi bde ba zhen par med par myang bar ldan/ /de thams cad kyi sngon 'gro sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid skyes bu tshul khrims sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa dang / /bde gshegs bka' thun mong ma yin pa'i pham pa brgyad las mi 'da' zhing / /bla ma la dad cing bsnyen bskur sems can la snying rje can/

/kyai rdo rje la dad cing dpe rgyud smin par byas pas rab phye ba'o/ /gong le'u bdun par dbang gsungs pa de'ang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bas de bstan pa de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma gtso mo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis sngon yang rdo rje 'chang la rjes 'jug rdo rje slob dpon la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir gsol ba btab pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje 'chang nyid rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin pas rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rjes bdag la stsol/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po dang / /rdo rje rigs lnga kun gyi ngo bo yin pas dam tshig mgon/ /las 'phrin las rnams thams cad sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sgo nas dgyes mdzod/ka /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba las mi 'da' bas dam tshig la gnas te dkyil 'khor ston pa'i dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ thig skud sar pa gzhan longs ma spyad pa/ 'jur mdud med pas mdzes par ldan/ /shin tu tshad ma dkyil 'khor gnyis 'gyur gtsang ma yis/ /he mi bskyod pas bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bya/ ga/de la 'di ni slob ma chen po'i gsol ba gdab pa'i dam tshig go /dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas go rī nga rgyal gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo zhi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs pa las byung pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas slob dpon gyis bshad du gsol de bzhin du phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyir rdo rje slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to//

༈ //de nas slob dpon bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis mig gnyis ma dang ta las nyi zlar byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs kun tu bltas te/ bgegs gsad gso byas nas dbang ldan du phyin te/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /snying rje'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ rdo rje yis ni 'od zer gyis gsal ba'i lus/ /sku gsum dbyer med yin pas las ni skyes pa spro/ /gal te la la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' stsal pa 'da' byed na/ /lus 'jig par 'di la 'chi bar the tsom med/ /gdon gyi rigs lus srul po dang kha cig gang / /bde ba chen po dang ldan pa'i ye shes byung pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin las skyes/ pa gcig yin na'ang / /zur de nas 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin 'dug stangs dang rkang stabs dang klu'i 'gyur tshul la sogs pas sa gzung ngo / cig bgegs ni chen po rnams/ /'khor lo yi ni lha snam tshun chad la brgyad nyid kyi/ /cha yis sgo ni mar cha chen gcig rab tu grags/ /sgo khyud sgo khang lha yi snam bu ni/ /cha chen gcig sgo yi tshad kyis tshad du bya/ /sgo yi phyed kyi cha chung gnyisacha ru ni/ /ya phubs dang ni 'gram 'dod yon nyid do/ /mchod snam cha gnyis nyid kyang de bzhin bya/ /dra ba'i snam bu rig byed cha chung gnyis phyed/ ca/dang por slob dpon shar bltas dang lhor bltas kyi tshangs pa'i thig gnyis dang ni/ /gnyis par slob dpon me dang srin por 'dug ste mtshams kyi thig dang yang / /gsum par ngos slob dpon me dang byang nas rlung dang lho dang de nas shar dang me las nub tu bltas te/ dbang po dang / chu bdag dang / nor bdag dang / gshin rje'i phyogs kyi bzhi yi ni bzhi/

/thig ni rab tu gdab par bya/ /tshangs thig nas cha chen gnyis bor nas ni/ /nang la cha gnyis phyi la bzhi ste/ de ltar cha drug tu ni gdab par bya/ /de nas sgo yi lha snam gyi tshul du tshad bor nas/ /dgu yi char nang gi cha chen re re la gsum gsum du ni rab tu gdab de dag phyed phyed bgos pas dkyil 'khor re re la cha bcu gnyis/ bcu gnyis su'o/ kha/de la 'di ni bgegs sam skyon sbyang pa'i dam tshig go /oṃ khaṃ sa nam mkhar rlob pas hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ de la 'di ni ye shes kyi thig spyan drang pa ste/ ye shes kyi thig gis sa gzhi byin gyis rlob pa oṃ me di ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ cha de la 'di ni thig gdab pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ de la 'di ni rdul tshon slob dpon gyis phyag g.yon pas dbang ldan pa re ka khyed gang ba lnga rim pa bzhin bri ba'i dam tshig ste/ 'di ni tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chos dbyings gyi ngo bo gdab pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bas sems can khams ni 'khor ba las thar par byed/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo kyai rdo rje rgyal po ches/ /thugs kyi rigs yin pas dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan du ni sha ra bha/ seng ge sngon po/ /me yi mtshams su dge sbyong dkar po bri/ /chos kyi 'khor lo ser po bden bral du/ /rlung du rdo rje khra bo bri bar bya/ /lcakhags kyu mthing kha/ shakar du bri bar bya/ /lho yi sgor ni zhags pa ser po nyid/ /nub sgor de bzhin lcags sgrogs dmar po te/ /byang du rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i dril bu 'o/ /dbus su thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri bsdus pa'i mtshan ma gzhan yang shes par bya'o/

/de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos sdig pa zhi ba dang / lha mnyes par bya ba dang / sngags kyi lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi grong khyer rab tu phye ba/ rdo rje rigs dang mthun pa'i thab khung sbyor ba yis/1 3/rdo rje'i las dang mthun pa'i sreg rdzas sbyor ba las/ 2/thab kyi dbyibs zlum po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /rgyas pa ra ba'i rdzing bu gzugs gru bzhi/ /dbang ni zla ba phyed pa 'dra/ /dgug pa la ni lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /gsad dang zhe sdang las la ni/ /nam mkha'i khams gru gsum dang mtshungs pa 'o/ /de bzhin skrod byed rmongs par byed pa skal ngan dang / /yan lag rengs par byed pa g.yo ba'i sbyor ba las/ /bud shing tsan dan a ka ru shing dang / /gzhan yang dri yi shing gi rtsa ba rkang 'thung nyid/ 4/sbyin sreg yan lag mes sbar nas/ /phyis dam tshig lha bskyed pa sogs byas pas ni yang ni ye shes kyi lha dgug par bya/ /oṃ ā+e h+yi kye tshur byon/ mahā chen po/ bhu ta 'byung po/ de ba ri shwi lha'i drang srong / twi dza skye med/ sa man ta bde bar dmigs pa/ gri hi twāṃ a hu ti dgang blug 'di/ mahā na ma a 'dir byon/ smin+sa ni hi to bha ba/ gau rī dang lcags kyu 'i phyag rgya nyid kyis dgug par bya/ /tsau rī zhags pa nyid kyis gzhug bya zhing / /bā+ai ta li lcags sgrog gis ni zhabs dag bcing / /ghasma ri dril bu 'khrol bas dbang du bya/1 6/la s+ye la sogs mchod brgyad dang / 2/mchod yon zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil dang 'thor byung sna tshogs byas nas ni/ /mar la sogs pa'i sbyor ba sreg rdzas kyang las/ /yang ni me ni mnyes par bya/ 3/de la 'di ni rdo rje mchod yon dbul ba'i gyi dam tshig ste/

oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā ra pra ti ts+tsha swāhā/ de la 'di ni zhabs bsil gyi dbul ba'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ sarba thams cad/ pa paṃ sdig pa/ da hā na badz+ra rdo rje sems dpa'/ ya badz+ra swa twā s+ya sarba pa paṃ da ha na swāhā/ de la 'di ni bsreg rdzas thams cad 'chu ba'i dam tshig gi sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje/ a na la mahā chen po/ bhu ta dz+wa la ya sbod pa/ sarba bhasmi ku ru thal bar ma/ sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭ/ drī sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya satwaṃ haṃ/ phyi dang po lhag pa'i lha'i dam tshig bskyed sogs byas pa'i nas rang 'dod pa'i lha ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ste/ oṃ e he h+yi kye tshur byon/ wa ga wan+ni bcom ldan 'das/ ha bh+ya kabh+ya na ye shes kyi lha/ sa ma ye dam tshig na tsa dngos/ a gan+haṃ/ sam+p+ra tits+tsha taṃ pu dzā ñca dwa mchod pa sogs/ pra si da me/ de la 'di ni ye shes pa gshegs pa dgyes par byed pa'i dam tshig ste/ oṃ kri ti wa sarba swatwā ar+tha sid+dhi dha t+ta ya tha a nu ga gats+tsha dhaṃ bud+dha bi ṣa yaṃ pu na ra ga ma na ya muḥ glus bskul nas bzhengs pa dang sgron ma'i las sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba dang / sbyin sreg gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis/ /sku gzugs khyad par du byed pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rab gnas ni/ /don dam spros bral chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin yang / kun rdzob tu 'jig rten tha snyad la gnas te/ /rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras gnas pa/ /rjes su dpag par rung ba yin/ /zhes pas mdor bsdus nas ni bstan par bya/ /bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dang por re zhig rig ma 'dzin/ /lag pa g.yas pas dril bu 'khrol bar 'dod pa dang / /dang po rkang g.yas rkyang pa'i a pa ra tsi ta sbyor ba las/

/lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba dang / /srod tho rangs thun skad ni chag pa dang / /gsar pa dri ma med pa'i gos kyis mgrin pa bcings pa dang / /rin chen sman lnga ni bh+ri ha ti dang kan ta ka ri ha sa dhe ba shi ta la/ 'bru lnga ni nas sran ma 'bras til gro'o/ /gyis yongs gang pa'i/ /bum pa sta gon gnas par bya bum par rigs lnga yum bskyed la/ /oṃ de wa dbus kyi bum par ma ma ki snying po pi tsu badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ mo ha ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ gti mug dga' ma gnos shig oṃ dwe shwa ra ti sde stang dga' ma a ti tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ ra ga ra ti 'dod chags dga' ma/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ rdo rje dga' ma lhag par gnos shig oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar sha ya dzaḥ ye shes pa dgug pa/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ 'di ni dam tshig la ye shes dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /shun pa u du bha ra shi ri sha/ /a shad ta dang nya kro ta/ /par karta dang rnam pa lnga/ /'o ma zho mar sbrang bu ram/ /lnga dang ba yu lnga/ /khyad par du yang dri tsan+dan dkar dmar gnyis/ ga bur/ dza ti gur gum lnga dang / /lus can la ni blugs pa la sogs sta gon gyi chos rnams rdzogs pa dang / /de nas nangs par dngos gzhi'i dus su yang mchod yon lnga ni le'u gnyis pa/ sngon bzhin bsham ste bya/ /yang sta gon gyi dus kyi ni de nyid sbyor bar bya/ /snga bar blugs shing sku gzugs bkru ba dang sbyang ba dang bskyed pa bya ste byin gyis brlab/ /mig la sogs skye mched byin gyis brlab par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni sku gsung thugs gnas gsum dgod/ /gtso bor ye shes pa bcug la dbang ni rang gi rigs nyid kyis bdag pos rgyas gdab/

/rjes la phyi mchod pa la sogs rim pas brtsam/ /rang snying dang rten gnyis ka'i gnas su ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsam/ /de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi sangs rgyas spyan drangs la rten la bzhugs par bsam la bsang gtor bya ye shes myang ba'am sbyar dri dbul/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'od 'phro ba'i rim pas mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad la sogs pa spro/ /rten de nyid la dmigs te/ stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems mchog bsams nas ni/ /rang gi thugs kha nas lha mo brgyad spros te sangs rgyas bstod pa yang dag brtsam/ /don dam par dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'khor gsum yongs dag gyis/ /stong pa snying rje tha dad med/ /ston pa khyod ni lhan cig spyod pa dang rjes su 'brel pa'i rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod pa'i yan lag /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mchog de kho na nyid thugs su chud pa rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag brnyes pa/ /gzhan don du khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i lha gzhal yas khang 'gro ba kun bsgrubs shing / snying rje chen po'i yan lag /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag /sgyu ma'i spros pas gang la gang 'dul rdo rje 'phen mdzad pa/ 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag /sku bzhi yi ge bzhi dang ldan pa 'brel pa'i he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i yid kyis rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la dgyes/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba'i rgyas bshad rdo rje se gol skad cig gis sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje bsgom pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang bas bsgom par bya/

/bdud rtsi ma dmigs pa las rdo rje yi ge bsam pas blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje phung por raṃ rnam par bsgom/ /de nas rdo rje 'tshed pa bsam a las thod pa der dam tshig gi bdud rtsi bskyed/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstim la/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i lce yi hūm̐ las sbyor ba las/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i rjes bcug ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nyid/ /rdo rje'i sngags oṃ āḥhūm̐ kyis bsang gtor bya/ /kha zas dang gtor ma dang bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs te bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje bdud rtsi ro myang pa'i rdo rje de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /le'u gnyis pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni stobs kyi bsgrub kyi rgyas bshad nam mkha'i khams chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus son par/ /stod rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa smad phur bu bris pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dang phur bu dang bdag gsum mi dmigs par byas la sangs rgyas dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /stobs kyis sangs rgyas phur bus gdab/ /rang 'od kyi rig ma'i chos 'byung grong khyer me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su yid 'ong bar/ /g.yas rdo rje g.yon bsdigs mdzub mdzad pa rdo rje mdzub mo'i sbyor ba las/ /gal te dngos grub mi ster na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang phur bus btab la gsad par bya/ /oṃ du ru du ru/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phur bus gdab pa chen po rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gong gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po bsgom par bya'i/ /rgyas bshad/ ma mo'i dkyil 'khor pad chos 'byung sogs dbus gnas 'dod chags dag pa par/

/rta mgrin kun brtag pa gzhan dbang gi rgya rnam par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga las bsgom par bya/ /gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya dbu rgyan la ni rdo rje chos longs sku/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgyas rdo rje chos kyi spyi bor pad ma dmar po spyi bor 'dzin/ /sku mdog dmar po khro bo stobs po che/ /yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /stong pa nyid bcu drug dag pas bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /byams pa'i thugs g.yas pa'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /gti mug dag pa g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ /rtsa zhal dang po thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dmar po shes par bya/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni chos nyid la 'gyur ba med pa bung ba mtshungs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi ngo bo zhal brgyad pa la bsdu dngos bzhi'i zhabs bzhi pa/ /rdo rje chos ni mtshan dpe 'bar ba gzi brjid che/ /sbyang gzhi 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /bdud bzhi zhabs bzhi pa mnyam par mnan pa po/ /kaṃ pa mo la sogs pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /kaṃ pa mo la sogs pa rdo rje rnam snang dran par bya/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje rnam snang longs sku 'dzin pa bsam/ /sku mdog dmar po gzi brjid che/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad dang / /zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rigs bdag gi spyi bor 'dzin/ /'dod chags chen po gti mug dag pa ma rjes chags pas/ /sa rnam par dag pa spyan dang gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /dang po'i zhal ni chos nyid rang bzhin gyi dag pas dkar po ste/ /nag po dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /nyi lag ma sogs ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/

/ser sna dag pa rdo rje nyi ma rnam par bsgom/ /cod pan rin chen 'dzin par bsam/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od chen po/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa ste 'jigs pa po/ /sems kyi rin chen rigs bdag gi spyi bor 'dzin/ /btso ma gser ltar gzi brjid che/ /dang po'i zhal ni 'dod don bsgrub pas ser po ste/ /g.yas pa sngon po 'dra ba 'o/ /g.yon pa zla 'od bzang po ste/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /sgo lcag ma la sogs pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /phrag dog rnam par dag pa rta mchog rnam par bsgom par bya/ /dbu rgyan ral gri 'dzin pa bsam/ /'phrin las la dbang bas margad ut+pal mtshungs pa 'o/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /bcu drug phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni sngo bsang ste/ /rta yi gzugs te 'jigs pa po/ /g.yas pa kha dog nag po ste/ /g.yon pa zla mdzes dri ma med/ /ral gri rigs bdag dngos grub spyi bor 'dzin/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /rdo rje nyi ma rta nyid kyi/ /yon tan dang 'phrin las bsdus nas phyag rgya 'di ni rin chen sgrol ma dang dam tshig sgrol ma'i gzugs/ /lha mo rnams yum bzhi ni phyag gnyis brjod/ /g.yas na gri gug dang ni g.yon na thod pa nyid/ /gong gi legs par dbang bskur slob ma gang gi rgyas bshad kye rdo rje la dkyil 'khor chos dbyings ye shes kyis rtog pa gcod pas ral gri mchog /phan par me long ye shes dang chos mthun pas me long de bzhin no/ /rta mgrin la ni reg bya dag pas gos bzang ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma la yon tan rin chen 'byung bas ni gser/ /rta mchog nyid la sems can gyi don la brtson pas 'gro mgyogs te ming dbang gis sogs/ /mchog tu dbang bskur thob rgyu yin te zhes pa slob ma rang la phan pa nyid kyi yon/

/ci ltar phan yon ni sangs rgyas 'bras bu myur du 'dod pa yis/ /dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la dus rtag par rgyun du yon dbul/ /sangs rgyas gang 'thob na slob dpon nyid rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin pas skal bzang rdo rje sems dpa' bdag /slob ma skal bzang thub pa rnam snang mdzad/ /skal bzang dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rje/ /skal bzang rdo rje nyi ma dang rta bdun rgyal po/ /gong gi bzlas dang bsgom la mngon dga' ba'i rgyas bshad de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog gi ngo bo yin pa rdo rje 'dzin pa pos/ mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i mi bskyod pa'i thugs snying po nas bskul ba dam tshig gi mchog gsungs pa/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya zungs shig dha ra ya/ zungs shig ma d+dha mi snang bar gyis shig ma d+dha/ badz+ra dh+rig gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ phaṭ swāhā/ de nas mi bskyod pa'i sngags chen bshad pa na/ /rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba skye ba snying rje che/ /thugs bskul bas 'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje'i sgrub pa po la ming dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das drug pa rdo rje 'chang rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa'i thugs snying po nas bskul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mgrin gyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma rdo rje chos/ gdul bya'i sems can la rjes su chags par lta ba dang 'da' bar mi bya bas dam tshig gis sa ma ya staṃ/ hu lu hu lu/ a ro li ka phaṭ swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam na/ /rdo rje chos ni grags chen po/ /'jigs shing thugs 'khrul bas skrag par gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje chos kyi dngos grub rab tu stsol/

/de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ phan pa'i sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ rtag pa/ swā shwā ta chos sku/ pa ra ma swā shwā ta e h+ye hi tshur byon/ mchod du dge ba ste spyod rgyas pa ste rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags su 'o/ /dzi na dzig phaṭ swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /spyir sangs rgyas kun dang khyad par du rnam snang de bzhin gshegs/ /brgyal zhing 'jigs par gyur nas ni/ /sangs rgyas de rnams sangs rgyas rnam snang gi dngos grub stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen rdo rje 'chang / thams cad la snyoms pa/ nyi ma zhes bya ba'i ye shes ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi thugs bskul ba'i sngags 'di gsungs pa/ rdo rje nyi ma nga rgyal gyi dbye ba drug gi mun pa sel ba bsam pa thams cad sel bar byed pas rin po che 'chang pas/ oṃ badz+ra sur+ya ta mo bi dha ma ha sa ma ya satwaṃ haṃ rat+na dh+rika phaṭ swāhā/ de nas sngags 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od chen po/ /'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mchog rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /phuḥ oṃ yod pa'ang snang / phuḥ rang bzhin gyi brda skad du/ phuḥ hi hi hi/ pra dz+nya dh+rika phaṭ rab tu byed pa'i shes rab mtshon par byed pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /swāhā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje don yod las kyi rigs 'byung ba/ /'jigs shing brgyal bar gyur nas ni/ /de rnams don yod dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i ra ba dang me ri'i phyi rol lam/

dbus kyi pho brang ngam/ lha'i gdan nam/ lus dkyil 'khor ro/ /gzugs dag pas gru bzhi dkyil nyid de/ /rdo rje can gyi zla phyed mtshungs thod pa'i dbyibs kyi bha ga mtshon/ /rdo rje chos kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngam 'dod chags dag pas pad ma 'dra/ /nyi ma 'dod don bsgrub pas yid bzhin nor bu zur dgu pa bzhin/ /rta mchog zhes bya de yi ni/ /rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pas thams cad du ni gru gsum mo/ /gong gi nga nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yum gyi gzugs kyis skyed par byed/ /kyi rgyas bshad rdo rje sems dpa'i yum mā ma ki phyag rgya che/ /phan pa'i phyag rgya sangs rgyas spyan nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje chos gos dkar mo kyi phyag rgya che/ /rin chen tog gi 'od byed ma dam tshig sgrol/ /don yod grub pa las kyi sgrol ma'i phyag rgya che/ /yum de rnams rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par ldan/ /stag gi pags pa bsnams sku smad dkris pa dang / /dbu skrar thod pa zla ba phyed pa sa brgyan pa ste/ /snyoms 'jug mchod par brtson pa'i sems pa sems chos kyi 'du shes yis/ /bde ba chen po la chags pas mig dmar mthong nas ni/ /lus lhar bskyed pa phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /chags pa'i sbyor bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bsgoms pa las bsgom par bya/ /las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //gong du/ de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub lte bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gyi rgyas bshad ni de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis/ /dman pa rnams kyis mos pa tsam yang dka' ba'i spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /dang po sems kyi brtan g.yo brtag pa'i phyir/ rdo rje spyod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ drod chung ngu dang 'bring po thob nas/

kun 'dar gsang ste spyod pa dang kun 'dar tshogs su spyad pa'i/ /rdo rje phyag rgya drod chen thob nas dngos grub thob pa'i yul dang grogs ngos gzung ba dang sems can smin pa'i phyir kun bzang gi spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ /me tog 'bras sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i nags tshal chen po'i mtha' nyid du/ /srid gsum mnyam par rtog pa'i sems dpa' chen po 'gro bar bya/ /de'i zas ci ltar bsgrub na nags tshal du ni rus pa'i rgyan la sogs pas brgyan te slong mos rgyu/ /zas ni bza' ba mi 'chi bcud chen po bzang pos brgyan pa nyid/ /shing gi lha la sogs pa de rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas ster/ /gnod sbyin chen po nags tshal bdag po'i rigs kun ni/ /rdo rje can de'i 'khor du 'gyur/ gong gi gti mug rdo rje mig la dgod/ /la sogs pa'i dgos pa bstan pa/ da ltar/ skyes pa sngar dang ni skye ba kun/ /ma 'ongs par skye bo gang zhig skye 'gyur ba/ /tha mal pa'i mig gti mug rdo rje'i bsgom pa'i sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje lha'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /khams gsum lam ni chos kyi rnga la sogs pa nyams dga' bar/ /sgra ni gang zhig da ltar rab grags pa/ /rna ba'i drung na mngon sum du gnas pa bzhin/ /rna ba la zhe sdang rdo rje'i sbyor ba las/ /lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pas thos sna lce lus la yang sbyor/ /sems can 'dod chags dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i kun gyi sems chen po/ /sems bag la nyal la sogs pa mtshon dka' lta bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dpe lag mthil skyu ru ra lnga bzhin/ /yid la bdag med ma la sogs pa rdo rje'i sems kyis shes par 'gyur/ /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/

/rang gis 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa rigs ni stong phrag gcig /rdo rje 'di'ang yid la bdag med ma sbyor bas dran 'gyur te/ /nyi ma gsum bzhin dran par 'gyur/ /sna lce lus gsum byin gyis brlab pas sgyu 'phrul dra ba du ma gcig las brgya byed/ du ma gcig tu byed yis/ /'dis ni snang bar byed par 'gyur/ /mngon shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// ༈ //gong gi zhi la sogs pa rtag tu bskul zhes pa'i rgyas bshad/ las gang la lha gang shis pa/ nad gdon sogs phan pa nyid kyis zhi ba ste/ /rdo rje nyi mas tshe dang longs spyod sogs rgyas pa 'o/ /rdo rje chos kyis rgyal po dang btsun mo sogs dbang zhes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas bla ma sangs rgyas smod sog gsad par bya/ /bsam pa'i khyad par zhi ba'i sems kyis nad pa'i spyi bo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas nad zhi ba ste/ /spyi bo nas bum pa dkar pos dbang ni yang dag brtsam par 'od dkar po'i 'phro bya/ /tshe la la sogs pa rgyas pa ra 'dod pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa 'od ser po spro ste/ /rdo rje char sprin rin chen bum pa ser pos dbang bskur lhar 'bab pa rab bsgom bya/ /rjes su bum pa dmar pos dbang bskur 'od dmar po spro chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /lha la sogs pa'i bu mo bkug nas bza' bar longs spyad par bya/ /drag po la me'i char sprin 'od dmar nag 'bab pa dang / /a khro'i sbyor ba la gnas te gdug pa'i sems kyis gsad par bya/ /bu mo gang 'gugs na 'phrog pa las dbang phyug ni u ma dkar mo ste/ /skye gnyis pa las tshangs ma nyid/ /dpal chu byung gi bu mo legs smin ni sred med bu las kyang /

/mchog sbyin ma bcag pa las ram bha brgya byin gyi bu mo thig le mchog ma nyid/ /bdud sdig can gyi chung ma rab tu dga' ma marga chu srin rgyal mtshan las lag tu khyer ba/ /phyag rgya de bkug la ji ltar bza' na chen po'i lha'i sku sbyor ba yis/ /de rnams 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas thams cad nye bar bza'/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la shin tu dga' ba'i sems kyis brtse/ /de ltar na thabs la mkhas pas 'dod pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthar ni swa hās zhi ba ste/ /rgyas pa'i dus su bho ṣa ṭa/ /mthar ni hūm̐ phaṭ gsad pa la/ /dbang dang dgug pa rim pa bzhin dza dang hri/ /las thams cad pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// ༈ //gong gi las bzhi'i sngags kyi mtha' rten/ de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur ston pa po/ /rdo rje rdo rje'i rigs mkha' 'gro ma rab grub phyir/ /lus ngag yid nyes byed spyod pas thub pas tshig 'di bka' stsal to/ /dang po yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa dang / /ri khrod dang ni sman ljongs su/ /bsam gtan gyi khang par stan bde ba la 'dug ste rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /snying kha'i sa bon aṃ gi 'od kyis bla ma sangs rgyas lha mo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la mchod par bya/ /rten gzung ba dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sngar byas pa'i sdig pa la 'gyod pa'i sems kyis sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ sangs rgyas dang nyan rang byang sems dang 'gro ba'i dge la dga' bas rjes yi rang / /don dam mi dmigs pa sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs 'khor gyi lha mo mchog la/

/dus byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku ni rab grub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /smon pa byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi nas rdo rje gur gyi lam rgyun la bstan pas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mngon mtho dang / nges legs kyi mgron du gnyer/ /'jug pa byang chub spyod mchog pha rol tu phyin pa yid 'ong drug spyad par bgyi/ /bsngo ba 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas grub par shog /slob dpon 'phags pas/ byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /nyon mongs pa dang snyoms gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ /tha mal pa'i sems kyi ngal ni gso bar bya/ /phyi nas byang chub ye shes kyi tshogs don dam sems gnas te/ 3/de rjes thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig go 2/bshad/ snang tshod du bden dang brtag na rang bzhin med par brdzun par dpyad pa yis/ /sgro skur gyi sdig pas brtags pas nye bar mi gos te/ /gdod ma nas ma skyes pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /snang tshod du rkyen las skye ba 'dir ni rab tu brjod/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta stong pa/ dz+nya na ye shes/ badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin stong pa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong mkhan yang stong / 1stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje bsgom pa rdo rje de nyid kyis ra ba dang / gur bcing ba yang rnam par bsgom par bya/ /der bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa las hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs bcur khro bo bcu ni rim pas dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed 'di bzhi thung zhing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sngon po tho ba thogs pa rnam snang gis brgyan pa/

lhor dkar po dbyug pa thogs pa la khro bo shes rab mthar/ /nub tu pad ma mthar byed dmar po 'od dpag med kyis/ byang du bgegs mthar byed/ nag po rdo rje thogs pa don yod kyis brgyan pa 'di bzhi brjid pa'i khro bo bzhir 'dod/ /mer ḍa ki khro bo lcags kyu/ bden bral du dbyug pa sngon/ /mi g.yo ba ral gri dang rlung du stobs chen rtse gsum rol pa'i khro bo bzhi skems pa rat+nas brgyan pa'o/ /dang / /gtsug tor ser po 'khor lo bsnams pa gdugs ni dkar po dang / /'og tu rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa nag po gsal shing thogs pa ni/ /rang dbus su rdo rje dril bu bsnams te de la mi bskyod pas brgyan te bdud rtsi'i sbyor bas thams cad du/ /de ltar khro bo khro bo'i bsgom sbyor bas zer pas bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad brgya ni khyab pa ru/ /bzlog pa la zhal phyir bsams nas bgegs bsrung ba la nang du ni bskrad par bya/ /bsrung ba'i nang du gzhi'i yan lag chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /rgyu'i yan lag yaṃ las rlung sngon po zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan par rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /raṃ las me dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yang ni waṃ las chu dkar po zlum po waṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa chu ni bsgom par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /brtul zhugs can gyis laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'o/ /dbang chen bsgom/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa la bh+rūm̐ steng du ni/ /rkyen gyi yan lag bdag nyid kyang ni yig 'bru gsum ho gnyis kyis brten pa bsgom par bya/

/de dag 'dres pa las/ bh+rūm̐ ser po las gnas kyi yan lag ni gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsams nas su/ /rnam pa lnga der zla ba dang ro bcas pa lnga'i steng du/ mngon byang lnga ni rab brtag bya/ /ye shes zla ba la me long ye shes sogs lnga las byung pa yi/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /dbus su bdag med ma rig ma'i skyes bu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ dharma dha tu chos kyi dbyings swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang bzhin gyi dag pa/ rdo rje mngon byang lnga las bzhengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa to/1 3/mig la sogs pa dbang po drug la gti mug sogs/ sems ma drug /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /ji ltar dgod na thugs kyi rdo rje snying khar zla ba la mkha' spyod ma/ /mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje sa spyod ma/ /dpral bar zla ba la sku la zhabs 'og gnas ma ste/ /de gsum sa bon hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ las byung pa 'o/ 2/bshad pa shar du rdo rje lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo nub tu chu bdag ma/ /byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbus su bdag med ma/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i gnas dbus mnan cing / /nang gi 'phar ma dkyil 'khor snying por bsgom par bya/ /shar du dkar mo lhor chom rkun nub tu ro langs ma/ /byang du ghasma ri ni sgo srung dang nye bas ma/ /dbang ldan du pu k+ka si dang mer ri khrod ma/ /dbang ldan du gdol pa rlung du g.yung mo phyi'i 'phar ma la mtshams su dgod/ /steng du gsung gi rdo rje mkha' spyod ma snying rje zhi la mi gnas zhes bshad/ /sku rdo rje ma 'og tu de bzhin shes pas srid la mi gnas pa sa spyod ma/

/de gnyis kyi dbus su bdag med mkha' 'gro ma/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor nyid du lha mo bco lnga sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom/ 5/de nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs la mchod la byang chub rdo rjes 'chang gis sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ /ji ltar chen po'i 'bras bu'i dbang che bstsal ba/ /bdag kyang 'khor ba'i du khaḥlas rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje zhes bos nas bdag la dbang bskur du stsol/ 6/de nas de rnams mgrin gcig tu dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis bdag pos phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang gsum gyi/10 /gnas las byung pa sbyin pa stsol bar mdzad/ /ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ 8/rig ma'i skyes bu dbang chen la/ /rigs lnga'i cod pan rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /des ni dkyil 'khor dbang dang ni/ /bstod dang mchod pa la sogs bya/ 4/dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te ye shes dam tshig la ye shes gzhug pa de bzhin yang / 9/lce yis rdo rje bdud rtsi myang byin gyis brlab la/ 11/dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te ye shes dam tshig la nang du brjod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /brtul zhugs can gyis sngags a li bco lnga'i yig 'bru lngas khyad par du byas pa bzlas bya/ /rnal 'byor ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud kyi nges tshig rang gi rnam par rtog pa skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ji ltar na he badz+ra 'am rdo rje gur la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces spyad par brjod par bgyi/

rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ /snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ ces pa'am/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs/ /rnal 'byor ma de'i rten lha mo dang bud med gtso bor gyur pa zhes mngon par brjod/ la ba bzhi/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba las yab yum thabs shes rab/ /gang phyir phyag rgya la brten nas lhan skyes de nyid brten tan tra zhes pa rgyud dang / rgyas pa dang / brten pa la 'jug pas 'dir brten pa la bya'o/ /pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/ /de ltar bskyed pa lha mo dang rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ces gtso bor gyur pas bshad/ /'o na sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin nam zhe na pha rol phyin pa kun gyi thabs/ /bsam gtan de'i dus su ma chags pas sbyin pa/ nyes pas ma gos pas shi la/ zhe mi sdang bas bzod pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ 1 9/dga' mdzes spro bas brtson 'grus/ ma yengs pas bsam gtan no/ /mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro bde ba'i 2mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ 3/nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gser gyi char pa gdan bzhi dang /4 6bshad pa bzhi/ zla gsang thig le/ 5/dga' chen ma dang ghasma ri/ bi rgyud/ 7/bde chen shin tu dgyes rol gsang ba yid 'phrog8 /aṣ+ṭa naṃ badz+ra ḍa ki tan tra zhes pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gzhan la phan rgyud brgyad/ thabs gtso bo/ 1/rtsa ba kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyal ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor ston pa 'bum lnga sangs rgyas kun/ 2/gsang mdzod rdo rje bdud rtsi bshad pa 'byung ba dang / 4/'khor lo sdom pa bshad pa gur gyi he ru ka 'byung gnas ni bshad/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud drug tu shes rab las shes rab gtso che ba rab tu grags/
